Salary Range:
CHF146,300.00 - CHF271,700.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland or Cambridge, United States (see separate posting)

Ready to shape the future of innovation at Novartis? As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 146.300 - CHF 271.700

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters . Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

• Grado avanzato in chimica o campo correlato, con forte preferenza per un grado di dottorato

En tant qu'avocat en brevets, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la protection des découvertes scientifiques révolutionnaires et dans l'accès aux médicaments qui changent la vie des patients dans le monde entier. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de R-D, vous dirigerez les décisions stratégiques en matière de propriété intellectuelle, créerez de solides portefeuilles de brevets et naviguerez dans des paysages juridiques complexes pour préserver l'innovation tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Fournir des conseils clairs, stratégiques et axés sur les affaires aux clients de la R-D de Novartis sur la protection des inventions, l'élaboration de portefeuilles, la stratégie de publication et les risques pour les tiers.

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF169,400.00 - CHF314,600.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: TA Head, PKS Immunology
Location: Basel

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary scientific leader to join us as TA Head, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunology. In this highly visible role, you will lead a cross-functional scientific organization spanning pharmacokinetics, clinical pharmacology, bioanalysis, and quantitative pharmacology across discovery, early development, and late-stage development. You will play a critical role in advancing the immunology portfolio, shaping integrated development strategies and enabling high-quality portfolio decisions.

As TA Head, PKS Immunology, you will provide strategic and scientific leadership across a portfolio of diverse modalities with a broad translational sciences remit. You will be responsible for defining fit-for-purpose development strategies across programs, ensuring scientific rigor in execution, and building strong partnerships across research, development, regulatory, and portfolio teams. This role requires a leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. You will also lead and develop scientists and serve as an important internal and external representative of the organization.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Define and implement integrated platform and program strategies from discovery through registration

• Support data-driven decision-making and differentiated development strategies for the immunology portfolio

• Oversee pharmacokinetic, clinical pharmacology, bioanalytical and quantitative pharmacology contributions to regulatory submissions and supporting documentation

• Support health authority interactions by ensuring high-quality scientific input into development and regulatory strategies

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across discovery, development, regulatory, and other key partner functions to ensure rigorous and efficient program execution

• Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing scientific team, including oversight of PKS Immunology scientists

• Serve as a scientific thought leader internally and externally through collaborations, publications, presentations, and participation in relevant scientific forums

• Promote operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and effective use of resources

• Leverage digital tools, AI, and automation, where appropriate, to enhance insight generation, efficiency, and decision-making

Leadership Behaviors in Action

• Deliver results through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and a strong focus on value and outcomes

• Demonstrate an enterprise mindset and strong ownership by prioritizing resources and decisions for maximum portfolio and patient impact

• Role‑model leadership behaviors through visible actions, continuous self‑reflection, and openness to feedback

• Build trust through transparent communication, clear accountability, and consistent delivery against commitments

• Empower others to innovate and improve while maintaining high scientific, ethical, and operational standards

AI Fluency

• Bring strong AI and digital fluency, using enterprise tools to enhance insight generation, decision‑making, and team productivity

• Accountable for the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI in line with enterprise AI governance and data protection standards

External Eminence

• Act as an external thought leader, advancing and elevating Novartis’ reputation in translational science and innovation

Operational Excellence

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid
Titre interne: TA Head, PKS Immunologie
Lieu: Bâle

Nous cherchons un leader scientifique accompli et visionnaire pour nous rejoindre en tant que chef de l'AT, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunologie. Dans ce rôle très visible, vous dirigerez une organisation scientifique interfonctionnelle couvrant la pharmacocinétique, la pharmacologie clinique, la bioanalyse et la pharmacologie quantitative tout au long de la découverte, du développement précoce et du développement tardif. Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'avancement du portefeuille d'immunologie, en élaborant des stratégies de développement intégrées et en permettant des décisions de portefeuille de haute qualité.

En tant que responsable de l'AT, PKS Immunology, vous assurerez un leadership stratégique et scientifique à travers un portefeuille de diverses modalités avec un large mandat en sciences translationnelles. Vous serez chargé de définir des stratégies de développement adaptées aux besoins des programmes, d'assurer la rigueur scientifique dans l'exécution et d'établir de solides partenariats entre les équipes de recherche, de développement, de réglementation et de portefeuille. Ce rôle exige un leader qui combine une expertise technique approfondie avec un leadership organisationnel fort, un jugement solide et la capacité d'influencer une organisation matricielle. Vous dirigerez et développerez également des scientifiques et serez un important représentant interne et externe de l'organisation.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies intégrées de programmes et de plates-formes, de la découverte à l'inscription

• Appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données et les stratégies de développement différencié pour le portefeuille d'immunologie

• Superviser la pharmacocinétique, la pharmacologie clinique, la bioanalyse et la pharmacologie quantitative dans les présentations réglementaires et les documents à l'appui

• Soutenir les interactions entre les autorités sanitaires en assurant une contribution scientifique de haute qualité aux stratégies de développement et de réglementation

• Favoriser la collaboration interfonctionnelle entre les fonctions de découverte, de développement, de réglementation et d'autres partenaires clés pour assurer une exécution rigoureuse et efficace du programme

• Bâtir, diriger, encadrer et former une équipe scientifique hautement performante, y compris la supervision des scientifiques en immunologie du SCP

• Servir de leader de la pensée scientifique à l'interne et à l'externe par des collaborations, des publications, des présentations et la participation à des forums scientifiques pertinents

• Promouvoir l'excellence opérationnelle par l'exécution disciplinée, l'amélioration continue et l'utilisation efficace des ressources

• Tirer parti des outils numériques, de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'automatisation, le cas échéant, pour améliorer la production d'information, l'efficacité et la prise de décisions

Comportements de leadership en action

• Fournir des résultats par une exécution disciplinée, une amélioration continue et une forte concentration sur la valeur et les résultats

• Démontrer un état d'esprit d'entreprise et une forte prise en main en accordant la priorité aux ressources et aux décisions pour un maximum d'impact sur le portefeuille et le patient

• Les comportements de leadership de modèle de rôle par des actions visibles, l'autoréflexion continue et l'ouverture à la rétroaction

• Renforcer la confiance grâce à une communication transparente, à une responsabilisation claire et à une exécution cohérente par rapport aux engagements

• Donner aux autres les moyens d'innover et d'améliorer tout en maintenant des normes scientifiques, éthiques et opérationnelles élevées

Fluctuation de l'IA

• Apportez de l'intelligence artificielle solide et de la fluidité numérique, en utilisant des outils d'entreprise pour améliorer la production de renseignements, la prise de décisions et la productivité de l'équipe

• Responsable de l'utilisation éthique, transparente et conforme de l'IA conformément aux normes de gouvernance et de protection des données de l'entreprise

Éminence extérieure

• Agir en tant que leader de la pensée externe, faire progresser et élever la réputation de Novartis dans la science translationnelle et l'innovation

Excellence opérationnelle

• Favoriser l'excellence opérationnelle grâce à l'exécution disciplinée, à l'amélioration continue et à l'utilisation efficace des ressources afin de maximiser la valeur des systèmes de comptabilité et de gestion

• Agir en tant que gestionnaire responsable des personnes, des données et des capacités numériques, en tirant parti de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité et la vitesse de décision

• Appliquer la priorité fondée sur la valeur et la sensibilisation aux ressources pour s'assurer que les efforts sont axés sur les résultats scientifiques et les résultats du portefeuille les plus importants.

Exigences essentielles

• PhD ou PharmD en pharmacocinétique, pharmacologie, pharmacothérapeutique, biochimie ou une discipline scientifique connexe

• Expérience importante de l'industrie biopharmaceutique, généralement 12 ans ou plus, couvrant la recherche et le développement précliniques et cliniques sur les médicaments, y compris la responsabilité de la haute direction

• Expérience de leadership des personnes démontrées, y compris l'embauche, le mentorat, l'encadrement et le développement des talents scientifiques

• Une bonne compréhension des exigences réglementaires mondiales et de l'expérience qui a contribué aux présentations telles que les IND, les DPIM, les ADN et les ABL

• Capacité éprouvée de travailler efficacement dans un environnement matriciel et interfonctionnel et influence entre les équipes et les niveaux organisationnels

• Excellente communication, pensée stratégique et compétences de résolution de problèmes, avec un haut degré de rigueur scientifique et un jugement solide

• Expérience en immunologie

• Expérience dans le développement d'essais bioanalytiques et les évaluations de l'immunogénicité

• Expérience démontrée selon différentes modalités, y compris les petites molécules, les mAbs et les thérapies cellulaires potentiellement CAR-T

• Familiarisation avec les activités de développement et d'enregistrement en phase tardive

• Expérience de l'application des outils numériques, de l'intelligence artificielle ou de l'apprentissage automatique à la prise de décisions scientifiques et à l'exécution du développement

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00

Job Description Summary
LI#- Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

At Novartis, we are reimagining medicine to improve and extend people's lives. As a Senior Principal Scientist / Associate Director within Molecular & Cellular Sciences (MCS), you will play a critical role in advancing exploratory biomarker strategies across our clinical pipeline. You will work at the intersection of biology, technology, and clinical development to deliver innovative biomarker solutions that enable smarter decisions and better outcomes for patients.

This is a highly visible scientific leadership position where you will influence biomarker strategies across multiple programs, collaborate with global experts, and drive the implementation of cutting-edge biomarker technologies from early development through clinical studies.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Lead a team of scientists responsible for developing, validating, and implementing exploratory soluble biomarker assays using LC-MS and immunoassay platforms across the Novartis portfolio.

• Serve as a subject matter expert in LC-MS and immunoassay technologies, such as ELISA, MSD, NULISA, and Ella.

• Oversee LC-MS and immunoassay laboratory operations, ensuring effective processes, procedures, resource planning, and project prioritization.

• Provide hands-on technical leadership to resolve analytical challenges and ensure high-quality method development, validation, sample analysis, and biomarker result delivery.

• Lead biomarker assay activities for clinical studies, including biomarker assays run internally or outsourced to strategic vendors.

• Analyze complex scientific data, interpret results, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for project teams and governance bodies.

• Identify emerging biomarkers, technologies, and methodologies that strengthen biomarker capabilities and support drug development decisions.

• Build strong collaborations across Novartis research functions and with external partners, including vendors, to advance biomarker strategy and execution.

• Represent Novartis through scientific publications, presentations, conferences, and external scientific engagement.

• Mentor, coach, and develop scientists and technical staff while fostering a culture of scientific excellence, innovation, and collaboration.

Essential Qualifications

• PhD with 5+ years or MSc with 8+ years of relevant industry experience in biomarker development, translational research, or related fields.

• Associate Director level will require previous people leadership experience.

• Strong expertise in soluble biomarker assay development, validation, and clinical implementation, including LC-MS and immunoassay platforms.

• Experience applying biomarker strategies from preclinical to clinical development to support program decisions and advance the portfolio.

• Proven scientific leadership, with the ability to shape strategy, solve technical challenges, and drive high-quality execution. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills in matrixed research, clinical, operational, and external partner environments.

• Solid experience mentoring and developing scientists or technical staff.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex science, influence stakeholders, and guide project teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong track record for providing scientific contributions in biomarkers, translational science, or analytical technologies.

• Established external scientific reputation through conferences, collaborations, publications, or consortia.

This is a dual posting. The final level & title of the offer role would be determined by the hiring team based on the skills, experience & capabilities required to perform the role at the level the role has been offered

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:
122,500.00 - 227,500.00 CHF Annual

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a
position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Analytical Thinking, Chemical Biology, Chemistry, Clinical Research, Clinical Trials, Collaboration, Curious Mindset, Data Analysis, Decision Making, Detail-Oriented, Drug Development, Ethics, Machine Learning (ML), Medical Research, Mentorship, Patient Care, Science, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management

Gamma di insalata:

Descrizione del lavoro
LI#- Hybrid
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera

A Novartis, stiamo rivisitando la medicina per migliorare ed estendere la vita delle persone. In qualità di Senior Principal Scientist / Associate Director all'interno di Scienze molecolari e cellulari (MCS), si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere strategie di biomarcatori esplorativi attraverso la nostra pipeline clinica. Potrai lavorare all'incrocio tra biologia, tecnologia e sviluppo clinico per fornire soluzioni biomarcatrici innovative che consentono decisioni più intelligenti e migliori risultati per i pazienti.

Questa è una posizione di leadership scientifica altamente visibile in cui influenzerà le strategie di biomarcatore attraverso programmi multipli, collaborare con esperti globali e guidare l'implementazione di tecnologie di biomarcatore all'avanguardia dal primo sviluppo attraverso studi clinici.

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Guidare un team di scienziati responsabili per lo sviluppo, la convalida e l'attuazione di saggi biomarcatori solubili esplorativi utilizzando piattaforme LC-MS e immunoassay attraverso il portafoglio Novartis.

• Servire come esperto di materia in tecnologie LC-MS e immunoassay, come ELISA, MSD, NULISA e Ella.

• Superare le operazioni di laboratorio LC-MS e immunoassay, assicurando processi efficaci, procedure, pianificazione delle risorse e priorità del progetto.

• Fornire leadership tecnica pratica per risolvere le sfide analitiche e garantire lo sviluppo di metodi di alta qualità, la validazione, l'analisi dei campioni e la consegna dei risultati del biomarcatore.

• Le attività di analisi del biomarcatore di piombo per gli studi clinici, tra cui le analisi del biomarcatore funzionano internamente o esternamente ai fornitori strategici.

• Analizzare i dati scientifici complessi, interpretare i risultati e tradurre i risultati in raccomandazioni attuabili per team di progetto e enti di governance.

• Identificare biomarcatori emergenti, tecnologie e metodologie che rafforzano le capacità di biomarcatore e supportano le decisioni di sviluppo della droga.

• Costruire forti collaborazioni tra le funzioni di ricerca Novartis e con partner esterni, inclusi i fornitori, per avanzare la strategia e l'esecuzione del biomarcatore.

• Rappresentare Novartis attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche, presentazioni, conferenze e impegno scientifico esterno.

• Mentore, allenatore, e sviluppare scienziati e personale tecnico, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza scientifica, innovazione e collaborazione.

Qualifiche essenziali

• PhD con 5+ anni o MSc con 8+ anni di esperienza del settore rilevante nello sviluppo del biomarcatore, nella ricerca traduttiva o nei campi correlati.

• Il livello di amministratore associato richiederà precedenti esperienze di leadership.

• Forte competenza nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione clinica del test biomarca solubile, comprese le piattaforme LC-MS e immunoassay.

• Esperienza nell'applicazione di strategie di biomarcatore dal preclinico allo sviluppo clinico per supportare le decisioni del programma e avanzare il portafoglio.

• Proventa leadership scientifica, con la capacità di modellare la strategia, risolvere le sfide tecniche e guidare l'esecuzione di alta qualità. Forte capacità di collaborazione interfunzionale in ambienti di ricerca matrice, clinici, operativi e partner esterni.

• Esperienza solida mentoring e sviluppo di scienziati o personale tecnico.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di spiegare la scienza complessa, influenzare gli stakeholder e guidare i team di progetto.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Forte track record per fornire contributi scientifici in biomarcatori, scienza traduttiva, o tecnologie analitiche.

• Fondata la reputazione scientifica esterna attraverso conferenze, collaborazioni, pubblicazioni o consorzi.

Questa è una doppia pubblicazione. Il livello finale & titolo del ruolo di offerta sarebbe determinato dal team di assunzione basato sulle competenze, esperienze e capacità necessarie per svolgere il ruolo a livello il ruolo è stato offerto

Vantaggi e premi
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Bei Novartis überdenken wir die Medizin, um das Leben der Menschen zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Als Senior Principal Scientist / Associate Director bei Molecular & Cellular Sciences (MCS) spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung explorativer Biomarker-Strategien in unserer klinischen Pipeline. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Biologie, Technologie und klinischer Entwicklung, um innovative Biomarker-Lösungen zu liefern, die intelligentere Entscheidungen und bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten ermöglichen.

Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare wissenschaftliche Führungsposition, in der Sie Biomarker-Strategien über mehrere Programme hinweg beeinflussen, mit globalen Experten zusammenarbeiten und die Implementierung modernster Biomarker-Technologien von der frühen Entwicklung bis hin zu klinischen Studien vorantreiben.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie ein Team von Wissenschaftlern, die für die Entwicklung, Validierung und Implementierung von explorativen löslichen Biomarker-Assays mit LC-MS und Immunoassay-Plattformen im gesamten Novartis-Portfolio verantwortlich sind.

• Dienen Sie als Fachexperte für LC-MS und Immunoassay-Technologien wie ELISA, MSD, NULISA und Ella.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie den LC-MS- und Immunoassay-Laborbetrieb und gewährleisten Sie effektive Prozesse, Verfahren, Ressourcenplanung und Projektpriorisierung.

• Geben Sie praktische technische Führung, um analytische Herausforderungen zu lösen und eine qualitativ hochwertige Methodenentwicklung, Validierung, Probenanalyse und Biomarker-Ergebnislieferung sicherzustellen.

• Leitende Biomarker-Assay-Aktivitäten für klinische Studien, einschließlich Biomarker-Assays, die intern durchgeführt oder an strategische Anbieter ausgelagert werden.

• Analysieren Sie komplexe wissenschaftliche Daten, interpretieren Sie Ergebnisse und übersetzen Sie die Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Empfehlungen für Projektteams und Leitungsgremien.

• Identifizieren Sie neue Biomarker, Technologien und Methoden, die die Biomarkerfähigkeiten stärken und Entscheidungen zur Arzneimittelentwicklung unterstützen.

• Aufbau starker Kooperationen zwischen Novartis-Forschungsfunktionen und mit externen Partnern, einschließlich Anbietern, um die Biomarker-Strategie und -Ausführung voranzutreiben.

• Repräsentieren Sie Novartis durch wissenschaftliche Publikationen, Präsentationen, Konferenzen und externes wissenschaftliches Engagement.

• Mentor, Coach und entwickeln Wissenschaftler und technisches Personal, während eine Kultur der wissenschaftlichen Exzellenz, Innovation und Zusammenarbeit zu fördern.

Grundqualifikationen

• PhD mit 5+ Jahren oder MSc mit 8+ Jahren einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung in der Biomarker-Entwicklung, translationalen Forschung oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Associate Director-Ebene erfordert vorherige Führungserfahrung.

• Starke Expertise in der Entwicklung, Validierung und klinischen Umsetzung von löslichen Biomarker-Assays, einschließlich LC-MS- und Immunoassay-Plattformen.

• Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Biomarker-Strategien von der präklinischen bis zur klinischen Entwicklung, um Programmentscheidungen zu unterstützen und das Portfolio voranzutreiben.

• Bewährte wissenschaftliche Führung, mit der Fähigkeit, Strategie zu gestalten, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und eine qualitativ hochwertige Ausführung voranzutreiben. Starke funktionsübergreifende Kollaborationsfähigkeiten in matrixförmigen Forschungs-, klinischen, operativen und externen Partnerumgebungen.

• Solide Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Entwicklung von Wissenschaftlern oder technischem Personal.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Wissenschaft zu erklären, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und Projektteams zu führen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Beiträge zu Biomarkern, translationaler Wissenschaft oder analytischen Technologien.

• Etablierte externe wissenschaftliche Reputation durch Konferenzen, Kooperationen, Publikationen oder Konsortien.

Dies ist ein Dual Posting. Die endgültige Ebene und der Titel der Angebotsrolle werden vom Einstellungsteam auf der Grundlage der Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten festgelegt, die erforderlich sind, um die Rolle auf der Ebene auszuführen, auf der die Rolle angeboten wurde

Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen.

En étroite collaboration avec les avocats en brevets, les scientifiques et les équipes d'affaires mondiales, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la prise de décisions éclairées qui aident à apporter des médicaments novateurs aux patients du monde entier.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Effectuer des recherches en matière de brevets et de littérature scientifique pour appuyer les décisions essentielles en matière de propriété intellectuelle et d'affaires.

• Élaborer des stratégies de recherche novatrices à l'aide de méthodes de recherche avancées et de bases de données spécialisées sur les brevets.

• Fournir des analyses de brevets exploitables à l'appui des évaluations de diligence raisonnable, des litiges et de la liberté d'exploitation.

• Établir des partenariats avec les avocats en brevets, les scientifiques et les équipes d'affaires pour définir les objectifs et fournir des renseignements.

• Traduire des informations techniques complexes en recommandations claires pour divers intervenants.

• Maintenir des documents de haute qualité, des dossiers de recherche et des normes de confidentialité pour tous les projets.

• Renforcer l'expertise organisationnelle en partageant les pratiques exemplaires et en surveillant l'évolution de l'industrie.

Exigences essentielles

• (Prof.) Maîtrise (ou doctorat) en biologie ou en biochimie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.

• Expérience en recherche sur les brevets, en recherche sur la propriété intellectuelle, en recherche technique ou en analyse des brevets.

• Compétence à l'aide de bases de données sur les brevets et la littérature scientifique et de plateformes de recherche avancées.

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de recherche avec une attention exceptionnelle au détail.

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de collaborer efficacement dans un environnement mondial.

• La connaissance des industries pharmaceutiques, de la biotechnologie, des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie connexes est un plus

Avantages et récompenses
À Novartis, nous sommes déterminés à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la rendent possible.

Les récompenses de faire partie de notre équipe vont bien au-delà de la rémunération de base et des incitatifs. En outre, nous offrons des options de travail flexibles et hybrides, dans la mesure du possible, et un congé parental payé d'au moins 14 semaines.

#LI-Onsite

The Oncology Data Science team in Biomedical Research at Novartis works at the intersection of oncology drug discovery, computational biology, AI/ML, and data engineering. We are seeking an enthusiastic AI/ML scientist with strong curiosity for AI-driven drug discovery to join the AI & Innovation team.
This role will apply advanced AI approaches to generate insights from complex multi-modal datasets and advance our target and biomarker discovery efforts.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Design, develop, implement and apply advanced machine learning algorithms, AI models, and platforms to enable the delivery of predictive insights from pre-clinical, clinical and real-world evidence datasets.

• Demonstrate value of innovative AI techniques in the context of drug target identification, biomolecular interaction modeling, drug development and biomarker discovery.

• Work with foundational models, including pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose, and multi-modal models to advance generative AI applications in drug discovery.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and adopt best practices for ML-ready data.

• Contribute to scientific publications and present results at internal and external scientific conferences.

Requirements:

• Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology or related field.

• Strong experience in one or more of the following areas: generative AI, biomedical foundation models, geometric deep learning, multi-modal learning, and large-scale knowledge graphs.

• Excellent programming skills and proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, with openness to learning new tools and technologies.

• Practical experience across ML and LLM software stack, including feature engineering, model development, deployment, and validation.

• Prior experience working with omics data and familiarity with oncology drug development.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex data insights and recommendations to cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated strong research skills, evidenced by publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences and/or leading scientific journals.

Rewards

#LI-Sul posto

Il team Oncology Data Science di Biomedical Research presso Novartis opera all'intersezione tra la scoperta di farmaci oncologici, la biologia computazionale, l'IA/ML e l'ingegneria dei dati. Siamo alla ricerca di uno/una scienziato/a di IA/ML entusiasta, con una forte curiosità per la scoperta di farmaci guidata dall'IA, che si unisca al team AI & Innovation.

Questo ruolo applicherà approcci avanzati di IA per generare insight da dataset complessi e multimodali e far progredire le nostre attività di scoperta di target e biomarcatori.

Descrizione del ruolo

Responsabilità principali:
- Progettare, sviluppare, implementare e applicare algoritmi avanzati di machine learning, modelli di IA e piattaforme per consentire la generazione di insight predittivi da dataset di evidenze precliniche, cliniche e del mondo reale.
- Dimostrare il valore di tecniche innovative di IA nell'ambito dell'identificazione di target farmacologici, della modellizzazione delle interazioni biomolecolari, dello sviluppo di farmaci e della scoperta di biomarcatori.
- Lavorare con modelli fondazionali, inclusi modelli preaddestrati, autosupervisionati, multiuso e multimodali, per far progredire le applicazioni dell'IA generativa nella scoperta di farmaci.
- Collaborare con team interfunzionali per sviluppare e adottare le migliori pratiche per dati pronti per il machine learning.
- Contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche e presentare i risultati a conferenze scientifiche interne ed esterne.

Requisiti:
- Dottorato di ricerca in Machine Learning, Informatica, Matematica applicata, Biologia computazionale o disciplina correlata.
- Solida esperienza in una o più delle seguenti aree: IA generativa, modelli fondazionali biomedici, deep learning geometrico, apprendimento multimodale e grafi della conoscenza su larga scala.
- Eccellenti competenze di programmazione e padronanza di framework di deep learning come PyTorch, con disponibilità ad apprendere nuovi strumenti e tecnologie.
- Esperienza pratica nello stack software per ML e LLM, inclusi il feature engineering, lo sviluppo dei modelli, la messa in produzione e la validazione.
- Precedente esperienza nel lavoro con dati omici e familiarità con lo sviluppo di farmaci oncologici.
- Eccellenti capacità comunicative, con la capacità di comunicare insight complessi sui dati e raccomandazioni a team interfunzionali.
- Solide capacità di ricerca dimostrate, come evidenziato da pubblicazioni in conferenze ML/IA di primo livello e/o in importanti riviste scientifiche.

Ricompense
In Novartis, ci impegniamo a reinventare insieme la medicina - e a premiare le persone che lo rendono possibile.

I vantaggi di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo inoltre una varietà di benefit in natura competitivi per aiutarti a prosperare a livello personale e professionale, come piani assicurativi, piani pensionistici, risorse per il benessere e programmi globali di riconoscimento. Inoltre, offriamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, ove possibile, e un congedo parentale retribuito di almeno 14 settimane.

Fascia salariale annua di base prevista per il ruolo:
- Svizzera: 78,400.00 - 145,600.00 CHF all'anno

La retribuzione offerta viene determinata sulla base di obiettivi neutrali rispetto al genere, quali abilità, competenze ed esperienza pertinenti, in conformità alla politica di definizione delle retribuzioni di Novartis e, dopo l'ingresso in Novartis, sarà riesaminata periodicamente.

Oltre alla retribuzione base, potresti avere diritto a un bonus basato sulle prestazioni, a seconda di determinati parametri di rendimento. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di candidatura.

L'equità retributiva è un principio fondamentale della nostra politica occupazionale e riflette il nostro impegno a creare un ambiente diversificato, equo e inclusivo che tratti tutti i dipendenti con dignità e rispetto, come indicato nel nostro Codice etico.

Leggi il nostro opuscolo per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di ricompense complessive: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Nota: I benefit e la retribuzione possono variare a seconda del Paese e sono soggetti ai requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni dei contratti collettivi di lavoro, ove applicabili. Una panoramica completa del tuo pacchetto retributivo, compresi eventuali dettagli pertinenti dei contratti collettivi di lavoro applicabili al tuo ruolo in base alla tua sede di lavoro e all'entità datoriale Novartis, ti sarà comunicata separatamente durante il processo di candidatura.

Impegno per la diversità e l'inclusione / paragrafo EEO:
Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale e inclusivo e team diversificati rappresentativi dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Perché Novartis:
Aiutare le persone affette da malattie e le loro famiglie richiede più della scienza innovativa. Richiede una comunità di persone brillanti e appassionate come te. Collaborare, sostenersi e ispirarsi a vicenda. Unirsi per ottenere scoperte rivoluzionarie che cambiano la vita dei pazienti. Pronti a creare insieme un futuro più luminoso? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Benefit e ricompense:
Leggi il nostro manuale per scoprire tutti i modi in cui ti aiuteremo a prosperare a livello personale e professionale: https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits-rewards

Competenze desiderate
Biostatistica, Mentalità curiosa, Governance dei dati, Alfabetizzazione ai dati, Qualità dei dati, Scienza dei dati, Visualizzazione dei dati, Algoritmi sui grafi, Agilità di apprendimento, Apprendimento automatico (ML), Algoritmi di apprendimento automatico, Python (linguaggio di programmazione), Analisi statistica, Analisi delle serie temporali

Zusammenfassung der Stellenbeschreibung
Standort: Basel oder Cambridge
Vor Ort

Für diese Position wird eine Umzugshilfe angeboten.
#LI-Vor Ort

Das Team für onkologische Datenwissenschaft in der biomedizinischen Forschung bei Novartis arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Wirkstoffforschung in der Onkologie, computergestützter Biologie, KI/ML und Datenengineering. Wir suchen eine engagierte KI-/ML-Wissenschaftlerin bzw. einen engagierten KI-/ML-Wissenschaftler mit großer Neugier auf KI-gestützte Wirkstoffforschung zur Verstärkung des KI- und Innovationsteams.

Diese Position wendet fortschrittliche KI-Ansätze an, um aus komplexen multimodalen Datensätzen Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und unsere Aktivitäten zur Identifizierung von Wirkstoffzielen und zur Entdeckung von Biomarkern voranzutreiben.

Stellenbeschreibung

Hauptaufgaben:
- Fortschrittliche Algorithmen für maschinelles Lernen, KI-Modelle und Plattformen entwerfen, entwickeln, implementieren und anwenden, um die Bereitstellung prädiktiver Erkenntnisse aus präklinischen, klinischen und Real-World-Evidence-Datensätzen zu ermöglichen.
- Den Mehrwert innovativer KI-Techniken im Kontext der Identifizierung von Wirkstoffzielen, der Modellierung biomolekularer Interaktionen, der Wirkstoffentwicklung und der Biomarker-Entdeckung aufzeigen.
- Mit Foundation-Modellen arbeiten, einschließlich vortrainierter, selbstüberwachter, vielseitig einsetzbarer und multimodaler Modelle, um generative KI-Anwendungen in der Wirkstoffforschung voranzutreiben.
- Mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Best Practices für ML-geeignete Daten zu entwickeln und zu übernehmen.
- Zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen beitragen und Ergebnisse auf internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen präsentieren.

Anforderungen:
- Promotion in maschinellem Lernen, Informatik, angewandter Mathematik, computergestützter Biologie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
- Ausgeprägte Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: generative KI, biomedizinische Foundation-Modelle, geometrisches Deep Learning, multimodales Lernen und groß angelegte Wissensgraphen.
- Ausgezeichnete Programmierkenntnisse und sichere Beherrschung von Deep-Learning-Frameworks wie PyTorch sowie Offenheit, neue Tools und Technologien zu erlernen.
- Praktische Erfahrung mit dem gesamten ML- und LLM-Software-Stack, einschließlich Feature Engineering, Modellentwicklung, Bereitstellung und Validierung.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Omics-Daten sowie Vertrautheit mit der Wirkstoffentwicklung in der Onkologie.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe aus Daten gewonnene Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen an funktionsübergreifende Teams zu vermitteln.
- Nachweislich ausgeprägte Forschungskompetenzen, belegt durch Publikationen auf erstklassigen ML-/KI-Konferenzen und/oder in führenden wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften.

Vergütung
Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, Medizin gemeinsam neu zu denken - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die dies möglich machen.

Die Vorteile, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundgehalt und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten außerdem eine Vielzahl wettbewerbsfähiger Sachleistungen an, die Ihnen helfen, sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Angebote für Ihr Wohlbefinden und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir, sofern möglich, flexible und hybride Arbeitsoptionen sowie mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub.

- Schweiz: 78,400.00 - 145,600.00 CHF jährlich

Das angebotene Gehalt wird auf Grundlage geschlechtsneutraler Kriterien wie relevanten Fähigkeiten, Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen gemäß der Richtlinie von Novartis zur Festlegung der Vergütung bestimmt und nach Ihrem Eintritt bei Novartis regelmäßig überprüft.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt können Sie abhängig von bestimmten Leistungsparametern möglicherweise Anspruch auf einen leistungsabhängigen Bonus haben. Weitere Einzelheiten werden während des Bewerbungsprozesses bereitgestellt.

Responsabilités principales :
- Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et appliquer des algorithmes avancés d'apprentissage automatique, des modèles d'IA et des plateformes afin de permettre la production d'analyses prédictives à partir d'ensembles de données précliniques, cliniques et de données du monde réel.
- Démontrer la valeur de techniques innovantes d'IA dans le contexte de l'identification de cibles thérapeutiques, de la modélisation des interactions biomoléculaires, du développement de médicaments et de la découverte de biomarqueurs.
- Travailler avec des modèles fondamentaux, notamment des modèles préentraînés, auto-supervisés, polyvalents et multimodaux, afin de faire progresser les applications de l'IA générative dans la découverte de médicaments.
- Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles afin de développer et d'adopter des bonnes pratiques pour des données prêtes pour le ML.
- Contribuer à des publications scientifiques et présenter les résultats lors de conférences scientifiques internes et externes.

Exigences :
- Doctorat en apprentissage automatique, informatique, mathématiques appliquées, biologie computationnelle ou dans un domaine connexe.
- Solide expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : IA générative, modèles fondamentaux biomédicaux, apprentissage profond géométrique, apprentissage multimodal et graphes de connaissances à grande échelle.
- Excellentes compétences en programmation et maîtrise de frameworks d'apprentissage profond tels que PyTorch, avec une ouverture à l'apprentissage de nouveaux outils et technologies.
- Expérience pratique de l'ensemble de la pile logicielle ML et LLM, notamment en ingénierie des caractéristiques, développement, déploiement et validation de modèles.
- Expérience préalable du travail avec des données omiques et bonne connaissance du développement de médicaments en oncologie.
- Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de communiquer des analyses de données et des recommandations complexes à des équipes interfonctionnelles.
- Solides compétences en recherche démontrées par des publications dans des conférences ML/IA de premier plan et/ou des revues scientifiques de référence.

Avantages
Chez Novartis, nous nous engageons à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les personnes qui rendent cela possible.

Les avantages à faire partie de notre équipe vont bien au-delà du salaire de base et des primes. Nous proposons également une variété d’avantages compétitifs en nature pour vous aider à vous épanouir sur les plans personnel et professionnel, notamment des régimes d’assurance, des régimes de retraite, des ressources favorisant le bien-être et des programmes mondiaux de reconnaissance. - Suisse : 78,400.00 - 145,600.00 CHF par an

En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à une prime fondée sur les performances, selon certains paramètres de performance. De plus amples informations vous seront fournies au cours du processus de candidature.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Supported.

At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people's lives. As Disease Area Lead, Immunology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the commercial success of our Immunology portfolio across Europe.

This highly visible regional leadership role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, ensuring that global priorities are translated into impactful country-level actions. You will partner closely with country commercial teams, Medical, Value & Access, and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive performance, enhance launch excellence, and build capabilities across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity to help deliver innovative therapies to patients living with immune-mediated diseases while influencing the future growth of one of Novartis' most strategic therapeutic areas.

Job Description
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Supported.

At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people's lives. As Disease Area Lead, Immunology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the commercial success of our Immunology portfolio across Europe.
This highly visible regional leadership role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, ensuring that global priorities are translated into impactful country-level actions. You will partner closely with country commercial teams, Medical, Value & Access, and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive performance, enhance launch excellence, and build capabilities across the region.
This is an exciting opportunity to help deliver innovative therapies to patients living with immune-mediated diseases while influencing the future growth of one of Novartis' most strategic therapeutic areas.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the execution of the Immunology disease area strategy across Europe, ensuring strong alignment between international direction and local implementation.

• Drive regional performance through market insight analysis, identification of growth opportunities, and implementation of high-impact actions across priority markets.

• Ensure consistent pull-through of brand strategies into country business plans, maximizing focus, execution excellence, and measurable outcomes.

• Partner with country teams to optimize portfolio performance while preparing markets for future growth opportunities and innovations.

• Lead launch readiness planning and execution, ensuring successful delivery of pre-launch and post-launch milestones.

• Drive commercial excellence through data-driven decision making, customer engagement optimization, segmentation, targeting, and omnichannel effectiveness.

• Collaborate closely with Medical, Value & Access, Regulatory, and Execution Excellence functions to deliver integrated business outcomes.

• Share best practices and build capabilities across markets, fostering a high-performance culture and strengthening Immunology expertise throughout the region.

• Influence and align stakeholders across a complex matrix organization while driving accountability for execution and results.

• Monitor competitive dynamics and healthcare market trends to inform strategic decisions and strengthen market preparedness.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, Marketing, or a related field.

• Significant experience in the pharmaceutical industry with a strong commercial background.

• Proven leadership experience at country level, such as Therapeutic Area Head, Marketing & Sales Head, Commercial Portfolio Lead, or equivalent commercial leadership role.

• Strong track record of developing and executing brand strategies that deliver measurable business impact.

• Experience leading or supporting product launches and lifecycle management within complex healthcare environments.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret market, performance, customer, and financial data to drive strategic decisions.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Commercial Excellence teams.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead through influence across matrix organizations.

• Experience working in regional and/or international environments with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

• Fluent English communication skills.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working across multiple European markets with a strong understanding of regional healthcare systems and market dynamics.

• Prior Immunology commercial leadership experience, including responsibility for biologics and/or specialty care portfolios.

• Experience driving launch excellence in innovative specialty medicines.

• Advanced understanding of customer engagement, omnichannel strategy, and commercial analytics.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 154,700.00 - 287,300.00 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Skills Desired
Asset Management, Business Development, Commercial Excellence, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Digital Marketing, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Key Account Management, Market Access, Market Share, Market Trends, People Management, Product Launches, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Profit and Loss (P&L), Sales, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Value Propositions

#LI-Hybrid #

Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per aiutare a fornire terapie innovative ai pazienti che vivono con malattie immuno-mediate, influenzando la crescita futura di una delle aree terapeutiche più strategiche di Novartis.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare l'esecuzione della strategia di area malattia di Immunology in tutta Europa, assicurando un forte allineamento tra direzione internazionale e implementazione locale.

• Condividere le migliori pratiche e costruire capacità sui mercati, promuovendo una cultura ad alte prestazioni e rafforzando l'esperienza di immunologia in tutta la regione.

• Monitorare le dinamiche competitive e le tendenze del mercato sanitario per informare le decisioni strategiche e rafforzare la preparazione del mercato.

Requisiti essenziali

• Laurea in Scienze della vita, Business, Marketing, o un campo relativo.

• Esperienza significativa nell'industria farmaceutica con un forte background commerciale.

• Provata esperienza di leadership a livello di paese, come Area terapeutica Capo, Marketing & Sales Head, Commercial Portfolio Lead, o equivalente ruolo di leadership commerciale.

• Forte track record di sviluppo e esecuzione di strategie di marca che forniscono un impatto commerciale misurabile.

• Esperienza leader o supporto lancio del prodotto e gestione del ciclo di vita in ambienti sanitari complessi.

• Capacità dimostrata di interpretare il mercato, le prestazioni, il cliente e i dati finanziari per guidare decisioni strategiche.

• Forte capacità di collaborazione interfunzionale, in particolare con i team Medical, Market Access, Regulatory e Commercial Excellence.

• Ottima gestione delle parti interessate, comunicazione e capacità di influenzare, tra cui la capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza tra le organizzazioni di matrice.

• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti regionali e/o internazionali con più stakeholder e priorità concorrenti.

• Capacità di comunicazione inglese fluida.

Requisiti desiderabili

• Esperienza di lavoro su più mercati europei con una forte comprensione dei sistemi sanitari regionali e delle dinamiche di mercato.

• Prima esperienza di leadership commerciale di Immunology, compresa la responsabilità per i portafogli di assistenza biologica e/o specialità.

• Esperienza di lancio eccellenza in farmaci speciali innovativi.

• Comprensione avanzata dell'impegno del cliente, della strategia omnicanale e dell'analisi commerciale.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: 154,700.00 - 287,300.00 CHF

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione. I premi azionari a lungo termine concessi a livello di gruppo possono anche essere parte del vostro pacchetto. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione.

Pay equity è un principio fondamentale della nostra politica occupazionale e riflette il nostro impegno a creare un ambiente diverso, equo e inclusivo che tratta tutti i dipendenti con dignità e rispetto, come descritto nel nostro Codice Etico.

Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del pacchetto di compensazione, compresi i dettagli relativi del contratto collettivo applicabile al vostro ruolo sulla base della vostra posizione di lavoro e dell'entità del datore di lavoro Novartis, sarà comunicata separatamente all'utente durante il processo di applicazione.

Impegno alla diversità e all'inclusione
Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale, inclusivo e rappresentativo di diverse squadre dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Perché Novartis: aiutare le persone con malattie e le loro famiglie prende più di scienza innovativa. Ci vuole una comunità di persone intelligenti e passionali come te. Collaborare, supportare e ispirarsi. Combinando per raggiungere scoperte che cambiano la vita dei pazienti. Pronti a creare un futuro più luminoso insieme? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Sie werden eng mit kaufmännischen Teams, Medical, Value & Access und anderen funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um die Leistung zu steigern, die Exzellenz der Markteinführung zu verbessern und Fähigkeiten in der gesamten Region aufzubauen.
Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, um Patienten mit immunvermittelten Krankheiten innovative Therapien zu liefern und gleichzeitig das zukünftige Wachstum eines der strategisch wichtigsten Therapiebereiche von Novartis zu beeinflussen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie die Umsetzung der Strategie für den Bereich Immunologie in ganz Europa an, um eine starke Ausrichtung zwischen internationaler Ausrichtung und lokaler Umsetzung sicherzustellen.

Grundlegende Anforderungen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Sciences, Business, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Bedeutende Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie mit einem starken kommerziellen Hintergrund.

• Nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung auf Länderebene, wie Therapeutic Area Head, Marketing & Sales Head, Commercial Portfolio Lead oder eine gleichwertige kommerzielle Führungsrolle.

Erwünschte Anforderungen

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in mehreren europäischen Märkten mit einem starken Verständnis der regionalen Gesundheitssysteme und Marktdynamik.

• Vorherige Erfahrung in der kommerziellen Immunologie, einschließlich der Verantwortung für Biologika und / oder Spezialpflegeportfolios.

• Erleben Sie die Einführung von Exzellenz in innovativen Spezialmedikamenten.

Vorteile & Belohnungen

Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen.

Job Description Summary
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) is the innovation engine of Novartis that collaborates across the company and beyond, focusing on powerful new technologies that have the potential to help produce therapeutic breakthroughs for patients. Translational Medicine (TM) is the clinical research arm of Novartis BR, and includes about 900 associates globally. TM plays a pivotal role in bringing innovative medicines to patients, by building on research advances to develop new therapies, and bridging drug discovery and clinical application.
The TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) is a group of physicians and clinical researchers who drive innovative science from discovery to the patient through the selection, profiling, and effective development of medicines. Translational medicine experts oversee Phase 1 and 2 clinical trials to demonstrate proof-of-mechanism and proof-of-concept (PoC) in patients, as well as support for later Phase 3 development. Translational medicine experts are key and highly visible members of global cross-functional project teams that design and implement early research and discovery projects, that then culminate in clinical PoC studies. Translational medicine experts collaborate with colleagues in biology and chemistry to identify targets in diseases with significant unmet medical needs and provide input on likely clinical development pathways. The early clinical trials led by our translational medicine experts are among the most critical steps in drug development at Novartis. After PoC and if the program proceeds to full development, the translational medicine expert continues as a key member of the full development team up to and including registration.
As a Cardiovascular Metabolism (CVM) TM Expert, you will collaborate with the CVM TM Head or other experienced TM Experts to develop high value decision-strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects and to lead global cross-functional project teams through the PoC phase and beyond.

Job Description
# LI- hybrid

TME Director Cardiovascular Metabolism

Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials research, data collection activities and clinical operations, serving a leadership role in the matrixed trial team. Establishes and approves scientific methods for design and implementation of clinical protocols, data collection systems and final reports. Support new and ongoing clinical research and clinical trials and ensure efficient and timely processing of confidentiality agreements and clinical agreements

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead global project teams through PoC phase to drive implementation of the PoC strategy; participate in project teams through program life cycle from NTRC to registration

• Responsible for clinical portions of the Integrated Development Plan (IDP) through PoC.

• Acts as medical monitor for one or more clinical studies.

• Communicate clinical team matters to project teams and relevant decision boards (such as the Disease Area Decision Board).

• Convene relevant (internal and external) leaders to consider proposed approach to PoC.

• Evaluate clinical centers and foster communication with crucial collaborating investigators.

• Oversee publication and external presentation of PoC clinical study results.

• Accountable for compound related biomarker strategies; work closely with biomarker experts in implementation.

• In collaboration with research scientists identify, develop and implement strategy for preclinical support of program related objectives; this includes assessment of medical need, proposal of clinical development pathways, and review of preclinical data for clinical implications and other relevant activities

• Participate in team presentations to Health Authorities as TM Expert

Essential Requirements:

• Doctoral degree, MD required with clinical subspecialty training preferred in cardiovascular disease or endocrinology/metabolic disease; Additional PhD/post-doctoral equivalent research preferred.

• At least 1-2 years’ experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech company, CRO, or academic medical center, or related experience; 5 plus years to be considered for Director level.

• Recognized for medical expertise.

• Recognized for scientific expertise and passion for science: respected by colleagues internally and externally, having made significant contributions to the field and created / established new concepts; record of high quality publications in international scientific journals.

• Excellent written and oral communication/presentation skills.

• Independence: Able to work independently on study planning and execution, and with supervision on project planning.

• Leadership of Collaborations: Able to lead multidisciplinary teams in a matrix organization.

• Innovation: Seeks out new clinical discovery opportunities and PoC approaches.

• Additional consideration for candidates with advanced research experience in data science, genetics/genomics, artificial intelligence applied to clinical research, or digital/wearable health science.

• Fluent oral and written English

This is a dual level posting. The final level & title of the offer role would be determined by the hiring team based on the skills, experience & capabilities required to perform the role at the level the role has been offered.

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

Director: 150,500.00 - 215,000.00 - 279,500.00 CHF Annual

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Descrizione del lavoro
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) è il motore di innovazione di Novartis che collabora in tutta l'azienda e oltre, concentrandosi su potenti nuove tecnologie che hanno il potenziale di contribuire a produrre scoperte terapeutiche per i pazienti. Medicina Traduttiva (TM) è il braccio di ricerca clinica di Novartis BR, e comprende circa 900 associati a livello globale. TM svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel portare farmaci innovativi ai pazienti, costruendo sui progressi della ricerca per sviluppare nuove terapie, e corrompere la scoperta della droga e l'applicazione clinica.
TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) è un gruppo di medici e ricercatori clinici che guidano la scienza innovativa dalla scoperta al paziente attraverso la selezione, la profilazione e lo sviluppo efficace dei farmaci. Esperti di medicina traduttiva supervisionano la fase 1 e 2 studi clinici per dimostrare la prova del meccanismo e la prova del concetto (PoC) nei pazienti, nonché il supporto per lo sviluppo successivo della fase 3. Esperti di medicina traduttiva sono membri chiave e altamente visibili di team di progetto interfunzionali globali che progettano e implementano i primi progetti di ricerca e scoperta, che poi culminano negli studi clinici del PoC. Esperti di medicina traduttiva collaborano con i colleghi in biologia e chimica per identificare gli obiettivi nelle malattie con significative esigenze mediche non misurate e fornire input su probabili percorsi di sviluppo clinico. I primi studi clinici condotti dai nostri esperti di medicina traduttiva sono tra i passi più critici nello sviluppo della droga a Novartis. Dopo PoC e se il programma procede a pieno sviluppo, l'esperto di medicina traduttiva continua come membro chiave del team di sviluppo completo fino a e compresa la registrazione.
Come esperto di Metabolismo cardiovascolare (CVM) TM, collaborerai con il CVM TM Head o altri esperti TM Experts per sviluppare strategie decisionali ad alto valore per la componente di Medicina Traduzionale dei progetti di sviluppo della droga e per condurre team di progetto multifunzionali globali attraverso la fase PoC e oltre.

Descrizione del lavoro
# LI- ibrido

TME Direttore Metabolismo cardiovascolare

Supera la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e l'interpretazione della ricerca di studi clinici, le attività di raccolta dati e le operazioni cliniche, servendo un ruolo di leadership nel team di prova matrice. Stabilisce e approva metodi scientifici per la progettazione e l'attuazione di protocolli clinici, sistemi di raccolta dati e relazioni finali. Sostenere la ricerca clinica e le sperimentazioni cliniche in corso e garantire un trattamento efficiente e tempestivo di accordi di riservatezza e accordi clinici

Responsabilità chiave:

• Leader team di progetto globali attraverso la fase PoC per guidare l'implementazione della strategia PoC; partecipare a team di progetto attraverso il ciclo di vita del programma da NTRC a registrazione

• Responsabile per le porzioni cliniche del Piano di Sviluppo Integrato (IDP) tramite PoC.

• Agisce come monitor medico per uno o più studi clinici.

• Comunicare le questioni del team clinico per i team di progetto e i comitati decisionali rilevanti (come il Consiglio di decisione Area Malattia).

• Convocare i leader rilevanti (interni ed esterni) per considerare l'approccio proposto al PoC.

• Valutare i centri clinici e promuovere la comunicazione con gli investigatori di collaborazione cruciali.

• Superare la pubblicazione e la presentazione esterna dei risultati dello studio clinico PoC.

Job Description Summary
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) is the innovation engine of Novartis that collaborates across the company and beyond, focusing on powerful new technologies that have the potential to help produce therapeutic breakthroughs for patients. Translational Medicine (TM) is the clinical research arm of Novartis BR, and includes about 900 associates globally. TM plays a pivotal role in bringing innovative medicines to patients, by building on research advances to develop new therapies, and bridging drug discovery and clinical application.
The TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) is a group of physicians and clinical researchers who drive innovative science from discovery to the patient through the selection, profiling, and effective development of medicines. Translational medicine experts oversee Phase 1 and 2 clinical trials to demonstrate proof-of-mechanism and proof-of-concept (PoC) in patients, as well as support for later Phase 3 development. Translational medicine experts are key and highly visible members of global cross-functional project teams that design and implement early research and discovery projects, that then culminate in clinical PoC studies. Translational medicine experts collaborate with colleagues in biology and chemistry to identify targets in diseases with significant unmet medical needs and provide input on likely clinical development pathways. The early clinical trials led by our translational medicine experts are among the most critical steps in drug development at Novartis. After PoC and if the program proceeds to full development, the translational medicine expert continues as a key member of the full development team up to and including registration.
As a Cardiovascular Metabolism (CVM) TM Expert, you will collaborate with the CVM TM Head or other experienced TM Experts to develop high value decision-strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects and to lead global cross-functional project teams through the PoC phase and beyond.

Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) ist der Innovationsmotor von Novartis, der unternehmensweit und darüber hinaus zusammenarbeitet und sich auf leistungsstarke neue Technologien konzentriert, die das Potenzial haben, therapeutische Durchbrüche für Patienten zu erzielen. Translational Medicine (TM) ist der klinische Forschungszweig von Novartis BR und umfasst weltweit rund 900 Mitarbeiter. TM spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Bereitstellung innovativer Medikamente für Patienten, indem es auf den Forschungsfortschritten zur Entwicklung neuer Therapien aufbaut und die Wirkstoffforschung und klinische Anwendung verbindet.
Das TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) ist eine Gruppe von Ärzten und klinischen Forschern, die innovative Wissenschaft von der Entdeckung bis zum Patienten durch die Auswahl, Profilierung und effektive Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Translationale Medizin-Experten beaufsichtigen klinische Studien der Phase 1 und 2, um den Nachweis von Mechanik und Proof-of-Concept (PoC) bei Patienten sowie die Unterstützung für die spätere Entwicklung der Phase 3 zu demonstrieren. Translationale Medizin-Experten sind wichtige und gut sichtbare Mitglieder der globalen cross-funktionalen Projekt-teams, die design und Umsetzung der frühen Forschung und discovery-Projekte, die dann gipfeln in klinischen PoC-Studien. Die frühen klinischen Studien, die von unseren Experten für translationale Medizin geleitet werden, gehören zu den wichtigsten Schritten in der Arzneimittelentwicklung bei Novartis. Nach dem PoC und wenn das Programm zur vollständigen Entwicklung übergeht, bleibt der Experte für translationale Medizin bis zur Registrierung als wichtiges Mitglied des gesamten Entwicklungsteams tätig.
Als Experte für Herz-Kreislauf-Metabolismen (CVM) TM arbeiten Sie mit dem CVM TM-Leiter oder anderen erfahrenen TM-Experten zusammen, um hochwertige Entscheidungsstrategien für die Translational Medicine-Komponente von Medikamentenentwicklungsprojekten zu entwickeln und globale funktionsübergreifende Projektteams durch die PoC-Phase und darüber hinaus zu führen.
