Résumé de la description d'emploi
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) est le moteur d'innovation de Novartis qui collabore à travers l'entreprise et au-delà, en mettant l'accent sur de nouvelles technologies puissantes qui ont le potentiel d'aider à produire des percées thérapeutiques pour les patients. La médecine translationnelle (MC) est le bras de recherche clinique de Novartis BR et compte environ 900 associés dans le monde. TM joue un rôle central dans l'apport de médicaments innovants aux patients, en s'appuyant sur les progrès de la recherche pour développer de nouvelles thérapies, et en reliant la découverte de médicaments et l'application clinique.
Le TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) est un groupe de médecins et de chercheurs cliniques qui conduisent la science innovante de la découverte au patient par la sélection, le profilage et le développement efficace des médicaments. Les experts en médecine translationnelle supervisent les essais cliniques des phases 1 et 2 afin de démontrer la preuve du mécanisme et du concept chez les patients, ainsi que l'appui au développement ultérieur de la phase 3. Les experts en médecine translationnelle sont des membres clés et très visibles d'équipes mondiales de projets interfonctionnels qui conçoivent et mettent en oeuvre des projets de recherche et de découverte précoces, qui culminent ensuite dans les études cliniques du PdC. Les experts en médecine translationnelle collaborent avec des collègues en biologie et en chimie pour identifier des cibles dans des maladies ayant des besoins médicaux non satisfaits importants et fournir des commentaires sur les voies de développement clinique probables. Les premiers essais cliniques menés par nos experts en médecine translationnelle comptent parmi les étapes les plus critiques du développement des médicaments à Novartis. Après le PdC et si le programme procède au développement complet, l'expert en médecine translationnelle continue d'être un membre clé de l'équipe de développement complet jusqu'à l'inscription.
En tant qu'expert en métabolisme cardiovasculaire (MCV), vous collaborerez avec le responsable de MC ou d'autres experts en MC expérimentés pour élaborer des stratégies de décision de grande valeur pour le volet Médecine translationnelle des projets de développement de médicaments et diriger des équipes de projets interfonctionnels à l'échelle mondiale au cours de la phase du PdC et au-delà.

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
#LI-Hybrid
Standort: Basel

Translational Medicine Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) ist eine Gruppe von Ärzten und klinischen Forschern, die innovative Wissenschaft von der Entdeckung bis zum Patienten durch die Auswahl, Profilierung und frühe klinische Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Translational Medicine Experts (TMEs) betreuen Phase 1 First-in-Human (FiH) und Phase 2 Proof-of-Concept (PoC) und Dosisbereichsfindung (DRF) Studien zur Unterstützung der Phase 3 Entwicklung. TMEs sind wichtige und gut sichtbare Mitglieder globaler funktionsübergreifender Projektteams, die frühe Forschungs- und Entdeckungsprojekte entwerfen und umsetzen. TMEs arbeiten mit Kollegen aus Biologie und Chemie zusammen, um Ziele bei Krankheiten mit signifikanten ungedeckten medizinischen Bedürfnissen zu identifizieren und Input zu wahrscheinlichen klinischen Entwicklungspfaden zu liefern, klinische Entwicklungspläne in Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung in der Spätphase zu entwerfen, klinische Studienprotokolle zu entwerfen und als medizinische Leitfäden für diese Studien zu dienen.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Führen Sie globale klinische Studienteams durch die Entwicklung von Phase 1 und 2

• Entwurf des frühen klinischen Entwicklungsplans

• Handeln Sie als medizinischer Leiter für frühe klinische Studien

• Repräsentieren Sie das Team in relevanten Entscheidungsgremien

• Servieren Sie einen primären Ansprechpartner für interne und externe wichtige Meinungsführer

• Überwachung der Veröffentlichung und internen/externen Präsentation der Ergebnisse klinischer Studien

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Biomarker-Experten bei der Umsetzung

• Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungswissenschaftlern zur Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Strategie für die präklinische Unterstützung programmbezogener Ziele

• Aktiv an Interaktionen der Gesundheitsbehörde teilnehmen

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

• Arzt mit Board-Zertifizierung in der Gastroenterologie oder relevante medizinische Spezialität

• Mehrjährige klinische Erfahrung bei der Behandlung von IBD-Patienten (UC und CD).

• Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und unabhängig zu arbeiten

• Fähigkeit, multidisziplinäre Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu führen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten

Erwünschte Anforderungen:

• Forschungserfahrung (z.B. Ph.D.) ist ein Plus, aber keine strenge Anforderung

• Erfahrung in der Arzneimittelentwicklung als Studienforscher oder Pharma-Erfahrung sind ein Plus, aber keine strengen Anforderungen.

• Publikationen im Bereich IBD sind ein Plus, aber keine strenge Anforderung

Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf einen leistungsbezogenen Bonus, der von bestimmten Leistungsparametern abhängt.

Die Belohnungen, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundlohn und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten auch eine Vielzahl von Wettbewerbsvorteilen an, die Ihnen helfen, persönlich und professionell zu gedeihen, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Wohlbefindensressourcen und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir flexible und hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wo möglich, und mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub.

Les experts en médecine translationnelle supervisent les études de phase 1 sur le premier patient humain (FiH) et de phase 2 sur la preuve de concept (PoC) et sur l'intervalle de dose (DRF) à l'appui du développement de la phase 3. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel

Bringing life-changing medicines to millions of people, Novartis sits at the intersection of cutting-edge medical science and innovative digital technology. As a global company, the resources and opportunities for growth and development are plentiful including global and local cross functional careers, a diverse learning suite of thousands of programs & an in-house marketplace for rotations & project work. With strong medicines pipeline our current transformation will not just deliver growth for our business but continue to allow us to bring innovative medicines to patients quickly.

Biomarkers are critical components of translational research, enabling robust therapeutic and mechanistic hypothesis testing in early clinical development, and as precision medicine enablers e.g. defining patient subpopulations, predicting patient responses, and use as diagnostics.
The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Translational Medicine, partners with other Disease area, Translational Medicine, Global Development, and Commercial leadership for the development and implementation of innovative, complex, exploratory biomarker strategies, independent of clinical program stage, and provides an effective interface for transitioning projects to later stage development. The BMD TABH leads and develops a dedicated group of biomarker project team leads (BML) and therapeutic area biomarker leads (TABL) to develop and oversee clinical project strategies, plans and timelines

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Key leader to identify, develop, and drive disease, mechanistic biology, translational pharmacology and precision medicine approaches for the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio, leveraging diverse biomarker modalities e.g. genetics, genomics, proteins, cells, imaging, digital devices and technology/data science strategies

• Strategic decision-making and executive oversight in indication / patient selection, biomarker strategy formulation, and investigations into drug mechanisms of action

• Responsible for delivering clinical project and disease biology “fit for purpose” biomarker strategies/plans across the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio and leading reviews at Disease Area Decision Boards (DADBs), Biomarker Forum, Biomarker and Diagnostic Review Committee, TDSCs and governance boards

• Leads, mentors and develops a dedicated group of biomarker project team leads (BML) and therapeutic area biomarker leads (TABL) to develop and oversee clinical project strategies, plans and timelines

• Provides Novartis disease biomarker leadership internally and externally to drive innovative mid-long term disease area initiatives/consortium across biomarker/clinical study designs, endpoints, diagnostics and discovery strategies

• Provides insight into optimal selection of exploratory, “fit for purpose” and validated biomarkers (across modalities e.g. genetic, genomic, soluble, cellular, imaging, digital) to address clinical and biological mechanism questions, trial endpoints and identify responsive patient subpopulations

• Works in close collaboration with other functions in Biomedical Research and Development (e.g. TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DAs and DUs) to provide expertise, optimize portfolio value and issue resolution

• Responsible for high-quality contributions and review of study protocols, clinical study reports, Integrated Development Plans, and Clinical Pharmacology Plans

• Supports high quality internal and regulatory submissions/decisions e.g. proof of concept/mechanism, dose selection/escalation, safety and competitive differentiation claims

• Attends meetings with external parties including investigators, outside experts, and health authorities, as needed

Essential Requirements:

• PhD and/or MD desirable with broad biology/technology knowledge in the clinical biomarker field; medical and/or clinical genetics experience desired

• Deep expertise in drug development

• Substantial impactful experience working in Pharma and/or biotechnology R&D business functions, leading internal and external high performing diverse teams and matrix organizations

• Scientific excellence and clinical expertise in neurodegeneration, neuroimmunology, neuromuscular and neurogenetic diseases/biology evidenced by significant contributions to the field

• Demonstrated technical and scientific expertise in multiple areas for development of innovative biomarker solutions with experience in working across key modalities (eg xRNA, AAV, biotherapeutics and small molecules)

• Well-developed interpersonal skills with good presence and ability to influence and negotiate with senior leadership, experienced presenter and communicator

• Strong track record of people leadership

• Recognized internally and internationally externally by key stakeholders; in depth understanding of external environment/trends; develops a strong professional network

• Fluent in oral and written English; other languages e.g. German, French, Italian useful but not required

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Ubicazione: Basilea

Portando farmaci che cambiano la vita a milioni di persone, Novartis si trova all'incrocio tra scienza medica all'avanguardia e tecnologia digitale innovativa. Come azienda globale, le risorse e le opportunità per la crescita e lo sviluppo sono abbondanti tra cui carriere funzionali globali e locali, una suite di apprendimento diversificata di migliaia di programmi e un mercato interno per rotazioni e lavori di progetto. Con i farmaci forti conduciamo la nostra trasformazione attuale non solo consegnerà la crescita per il nostro business, ma continuiamo a permetterci di portare rapidamente farmaci innovativi ai pazienti.

I biomarcatori sono componenti critici della ricerca traduttiva, che permettono test terapeutici e meccanici robusti di ipotesi nel primo sviluppo clinico, e come abilitatori di medicina di precisione, ad esempio, la definizione delle sottopopolazioni del paziente, la predizione delle risposte del paziente e l'uso come diagnostica.
The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Medicina Traduttiva, partner con altre aree Malattia, Medicina Traduttiva, Sviluppo Globale e leadership commerciale per lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie innovative, complesse, esplorative di biomarcatori, indipendenti dalla fase di programma clinico, e fornisce un'interfaccia efficace per la transizione dei progetti allo sviluppo di fase successiva. Il BMD TABH conduce e sviluppa un gruppo dedicato di project team di biomarcatori porta (BML) e area terapeutica biomarker conduce (TABL) a sviluppare e supervisionare strategie di progetto cliniche, piani e tempi

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Leader chiave per identificare, sviluppare e guidare le malattie, la biologia meccanica, la farmacologia traduttiva e gli approcci di medicina di precisione per il portafoglio di Neuroscienze e DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative Medicine), sfruttando diverse modalità di biomarcatore quali genetica, genomica, proteine, cellule, imaging, dispositivi digitali e strategie di scienza dei dati

• Decisioni strategiche e supervisione esecutiva nell'indicazione / selezione del paziente, formulazione di strategia di biomarcatore e indagini sui meccanismi di azione della droga

• Responsabile per la fornitura di progetti clinici e biologia delle malattie “fit for purpose” strategie/piani biomarcatori attraverso il portafoglio di Neuroscienze e DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative Medicine) e le principali recensioni presso le Commissioni decisionali di Area Malattia (DADBs), Biomarker Forum, Biomarker e Diagnostic Review Committee, TDSCs e Governance Boards

• Leader, mentori e sviluppa un gruppo dedicato di project team di biomarcatori porta (BML) e area terapeutica biomarker conduce (TABL) a sviluppare e supervisionare strategie di progetto cliniche, piani e tempi

• Fornisce la leadership del biomarcatore della malattia di Novartis internamente ed esternamente per guidare innovative iniziative/consorzio di area della malattia a medio termine attraverso progetti di studio biomarca/clinico, endpoint, diagnostica e strategie di scoperta

• Fornisce informazioni sulla selezione ottimale di esploratori, “adatti allo scopo” e biomarcatori convalidati (tra le modalità, ad esempio genetico, genomico, solubile, cellulare, imaging, digitale) per affrontare domande di meccanismo clinico e biologico, endpoint di prova e identificare le sottopopolazioni del paziente reattivo

• Opere in stretta collaborazione con altre funzioni in Biomedical Research and Development (ad esempio TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DA e DU) per fornire competenze, ottimizzare il valore del portafoglio e la risoluzione dei problemi

• Responsabile per contributi di alta qualità e revisione dei protocolli di studio, rapporti di studio clinici, piani di sviluppo integrati e piani di farmacologia clinica

• Supporta sottomissioni / decisioni interne e regolamentari di alta qualità, ad esempio la prova del concetto/meccanismo, la selezione/escalation di dosi, la sicurezza e la differenziazione competitiva

• Partecipa alle riunioni con parti esterne, inclusi gli investigatori, gli esperti esterni e le autorità sanitarie, secondo le necessità

Requisiti essenziali:

• PhD e/o MD auspicabile con una vasta conoscenza di biologia/tecnologia nel campo dei biomarcatori clinici; esperienza di genetica medica e/o clinica desiderata

• Profonda competenza nello sviluppo della droga

• Esperienza di impatto sostanziale che lavora nelle funzioni aziendali di Pharma e/o biotecnologia R&D, leader interna ed esterna di team e organizzazioni di matrice

• Eccellenza scientifica e competenza clinica in neurodegenerazione, neuroimmunologia, neuromuscolare e neurogenetica malattie/biologia evidenziate da contributi significativi al settore

• Dimostrata competenza tecnica e scientifica in più aree per lo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative di biomarcatore con esperienza nel lavoro attraverso le modalità chiave (ad esempio xRNA, AAV, biotherapeutics e piccole molecole)

• Competenze interpersonali ben sviluppate con buona presenza e capacità di influenzare e negoziare con leadership senior, presentatore esperto e comunicatore

• Forte traccia record di leadership delle persone

• Riconosciuta internamente e internazionalmente da parti interessate chiave; una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente/trend esterni; sviluppa una forte rete professionale

• Fluente in inglese orale e scritto; altre lingue ad esempio tedesco, francese, italiano utile ma non richiesto

Biomarkers are critical components of translational research, enabling robust therapeutic and mechanistic hypothesis testing in early clinical development, and as precision medicine enablers e.g. defining patient subpopulations, predicting patient responses, and use as diagnostics.
The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Translational Medicine, partners with other Disease area, Translational Medicine, Global Development, and Commercial leadership for the development and implementation of innovative, complex, exploratory biomarker strategies, independent of clinical program stage, and provides an effective interface for transitioning projects to later stage development. Key Responsibilities:

• Key leader to identify, develop, and drive disease, mechanistic biology, translational pharmacology and precision medicine approaches for the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio, leveraging diverse biomarker modalities e.g. genetics, genomics, proteins, cells, imaging, digital devices and technology/data science strategies

• Attends meetings with external parties including investigators, outside experts, and health authorities, as needed

• PhD and/or MD desirable with broad biology/technology knowledge in the clinical biomarker field; medical and/or clinical genetics experience desired

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid
Lieu: Bâle

Apportant des médicaments qui changent la vie à des millions de personnes, Novartis se trouve à l'intersection des sciences médicales de pointe et des technologies numériques innovantes. En tant qu'entreprise mondiale, les ressources et les possibilités de croissance et de développement sont abondantes, y compris les carrières interfonctionnelles mondiales et locales, une série diversifiée de milliers de programmes et un marché interne pour les rotations et les travaux de projet. Avec de solides médicaments, notre transformation actuelle ne se contentera pas de stimuler notre activité, mais nous permettra d'apporter rapidement des médicaments innovants aux patients.

Les biomarqueurs sont des composantes essentielles de la recherche translationnelle, permettant des tests d'hypothèses thérapeutiques et mécanistes robustes au début du développement clinique, et en tant que catalyseurs de la médecine de précision, p. ex. la définition des sous-populations de patients, la prédiction des réponses des patients et leur utilisation comme diagnostic.
Le responsable du domaine thérapeutique (TABH) dans le domaine du développement des biomarqueurs (BMD) en médecine translationnelle, est partenaire d'autres domaines de la maladie, de la médecine translationnelle, du développement mondial et du leadership commercial pour l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies novatrices, complexes et exploratoires de biomarqueurs, indépendamment de l'étape du programme clinique, et fournit une interface efficace pour la transition des projets vers le développement ultérieur. Le BMD TABH dirige et développe un groupe dédié d'équipes de projets de biomarqueurs (BML) et de biomarqueurs de zone thérapeutique (TABL) pour élaborer et superviser des stratégies, des plans et des échéanciers de projets cliniques

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Chef de file pour identifier, développer et stimuler les maladies, la biologie mécaniste, la pharmacologie translationnelle et les approches de médecine de précision pour le portefeuille des Neurosciences et DARe (Maladies du vieillissement et médecine régénératrice), en tirant parti de diverses modalités de biomarqueurs, par exemple la génétique, la génomique, les protéines, les cellules, l'imagerie, les appareils numériques et les stratégies technologiques et scientifiques en matière de données

• Prise de décisions stratégiques et supervision exécutive en matière d'indication / sélection du patient, formulation de la stratégie de biomarqueur et enquêtes sur les mécanismes d'action antidrogue

• Responsable de la réalisation de projets cliniques et de la biologie des maladies.

• Dirige, mentore et développe un groupe spécialisé de chefs de projet de biomarqueurs (BML) et de chefs de projet de biomarqueurs de domaine thérapeutique (TABL) pour élaborer et superviser des stratégies, des plans et des échéanciers de projets cliniques

• Fournit à Novartis le leadership de biomarqueur de la maladie à l'interne et à l'externe pour stimuler des initiatives/consortiums innovateurs à moyen terme dans le domaine de la maladie à l'aide de modèles d'études biomarqueurs/cliniques, de paramètres, de diagnostics et de stratégies de découverte

• Fournit un aperçu de la sélection optimale des biomarqueurs exploratoires, adaptés à l'usage et validés (par exemple, les modalités génétiques, génomiques, solubles, cellulaires, imagerie, numériques) pour répondre aux questions sur les mécanismes cliniques et biologiques, les paramètres d'essai et identifier les sous-populations de patients sensibles

• Travaille en étroite collaboration avec d'autres fonctions dans la recherche et le développement biomédical (p. ex., TMDP, CSI, PKS, PCS, RA, DDCI, DA et UD) pour fournir une expertise, optimiser la valeur du portefeuille et la résolution des problèmes

• Responsable des contributions de haute qualité et de l'examen des protocoles d'étude, des rapports d'étude clinique, des plans de développement intégré et des plans de pharmacologie clinique

• Soutient des présentations/décisions internes et réglementaires de haute qualité, p. ex. preuve de concept/mécanisme, sélection/escalade des doses, allégations de sécurité et de différenciation concurrentielle

• Assister à des réunions avec des parties externes, y compris des enquêteurs, des experts extérieurs et des autorités sanitaires, au besoin

Exigences essentielles:

• PhD et/ou MD souhaitables avec de vastes connaissances en biologie/technologie dans le domaine des biomarqueurs cliniques; expérience médicale et/ou génétique clinique souhaitée

• Expertise approfondie en matière de développement des médicaments

• Expérience considérable dans le domaine de la R-D en pharmacie et/ou en biotechnologie, direction d'équipes et d'organisations matricielles de haute performance internes et externes

• Excellence scientifique et expertise clinique en neurodégénérescence, neuroimmunologie, neuromusculaire et neurogénétique maladies/biologie mises en évidence par des contributions importantes au domaine

• Expertise technique et scientifique démontrée dans de nombreux domaines pour le développement de solutions de biomarqueurs innovantes ayant de l'expérience dans le travail sur des modalités clés (par exemple xARN, AAV, biothérapeutique et petites molécules)

• Compétences interpersonnelles bien développées avec une bonne présence et une bonne capacité d'influencer et de négocier avec les cadres supérieurs, les présentateurs expérimentés et les communicateurs

• Forte expérience du leadership humain

• Reconnu à l'interne et à l'international par les principales parties prenantes; une compréhension approfondie de l'environnement et des tendances externes; développe un réseau professionnel solide

• Anglais parlé et écrit; d'autres langues, comme l'allemand, le français, l'italien utile mais non requis

Avantages et récompenses
À Novartis, nous nous engageons à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui y arrivent.

Job Description Summary
The Novartis Strategy & Growth, Therapeutic Area Strategy team for Neuroscience is seeking a new Therapeutic Area Strategy Director who will support the creation and update of a holistic TA strategy; provide early-phase commercial insights to project teams; guide TA-specific internal pipeline development and external licensing / acquisitions opportunities; and support integrated enterprise alignment across Biomedical Research (BR), Development, Strategy & Growth (S&G), and the Commercial US and International units.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Brings external benchmarking, analysis and insights, and judgement to support the TA Strategy Head in developing a holistic Novartis TA strategy that achieves sustainable growth in short, mid and long-term.

• Brings both understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and the core Therapeutic Areas (TA) and Disease area of Neuroscience to derive insightful and differentiating competitive advantages over our peers.

• Provides key commercial insights to the R&D project teams, particularly for early phase programs. To do this effectively, in-market experience in the US is critical.

• Analyses reports and publications to extract key messages, including building product forecasts.

• Supports development and delivery of TA-specific strategic external insights to support identification of growth opportunities, emerging competitive challenges and support creation of a third-party view around key strategic levers, and commissions targeted primary research.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree required. Advanced degree (PhD, MD or other advanced University degree) and / or equivalent experience in life science/healthcare; MBA or consulting or equivalent experience highly preferred.

• In-depth TA knowledge (or track record to acquire required TA expertise effectively and rapidly) in Neuroscience.

• Highly agile having the capacity to support a number of strategic DAs within a TA and multiple programs internal and external

• Substantial experience evaluating new product opportunities (through M&A, BD&L and internal re-search programs).

• At least 5-7 years of Industry pharma and/or medical devices Experience in Research & Development and/or commercial functions with experience conducting, commissioning, analyzing primary research

• Experience of strategy development and asset shaping early in lifecycle (any functional perspective)

• Recent (post 2015) local US in-market experience; local US experience includes working within the US market with the local US customers, US health care systems / systems

Il team Novartis Strategy & Growth, Therapeutic Area Strategy per la Neuroscience sta cercando un nuovo Direttore di Strategia per l'Area Terapeutica che supporterà la creazione e l'aggiornamento di una strategia TA olistica; fornire intuizioni commerciali di prima fase ai team di progetto; guidare lo sviluppo di pipeline interne TA-specific e le opportunità di licenze / acquisizioni esterne; e sostenere l'allineamento aziendale integrato in Biomedical Research (BR), Sviluppo, Strategy & Strategy & S&G; International Growth (S).

• Corso di laurea richiesto. Laurea avanzata (PhD, MD o altro grado universitario avanzato) e / o esperienza equivalente in scienze della vita / sanità; MBA o consulenza o esperienza equivalente altamente preferito.

• Conoscenza TA approfondita (o track record per acquisire competenze TA necessarie in modo efficace e rapido) in neuroscienza.

• Altamente agile avere la capacità di supportare un certo numero di DA strategici all'interno di un TA e programmi multipli interni ed esterni

• Esperienza sostanziale che valuta nuove opportunità di prodotto (tramite M&A, BD&L e programmi di ricerca interni).

• Almeno 5-7 anni di Industria farmaceutica e/o dispositivi medici Esperienza in Ricerca e Sviluppo e/o funzioni commerciali con esperienza di conduzione, messa in servizio, analisi della ricerca primaria

• Esperienza di sviluppo strategico e asset shaping precoce nel ciclo di vita (qualsiasi prospettiva funzionale)

• Recenti (post 2015) esperienza locale negli Stati Uniti nel mercato; l'esperienza locale degli Stati Uniti include il lavoro all'interno del mercato americano con i clienti locali degli Stati Uniti, sistemi sanitari degli Stati Uniti / sistemi

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
L'équipe de la Stratégie et de la croissance de Novartis, région thérapeutique, recherche un nouveau directeur de la Stratégie sur les zones thérapeutiques qui appuiera la création et la mise à jour d'une stratégie globale de TA; fournira des renseignements commerciaux en phase initiale aux équipes de projet; guidera le développement de pipelines internes propres à l'AT et les possibilités d'octroi de licences et d'acquisitions externes; et appuiera l'harmonisation intégrée des entreprises entre la recherche biomédicale (RS), le développement, la stratégie et la croissance (S&G), et les unités commerciales américaines et internationales.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Apporte une analyse, une analyse et un jugement externes pour soutenir le chef de la stratégie de l'AT dans l'élaboration d'une stratégie globale de l'AT de Novartis qui réalise une croissance durable à court, à moyen et à long terme.

• Apporte à la fois la compréhension de l'industrie pharmaceutique et des domaines thérapeutiques de base (TA) et de la maladie des neurosciences pour obtenir des avantages concurrentiels éclairés et différenciés par rapport à nos pairs.

• Fournit des renseignements commerciaux clés aux équipes de projets de R-D, en particulier pour les programmes en phase initiale. Pour ce faire, l'expérience acquise sur le marché américain est essentielle.

• Analyser les rapports et les publications pour extraire les messages clés, y compris les prévisions de produits de construction.

• Soutient l'élaboration et la prestation de renseignements externes stratégiques propres à l'AT pour appuyer l'identification des possibilités de croissance, les nouveaux défis concurrentiels et la création d'un point de vue de tiers sur les principaux leviers stratégiques, et les commissions ont ciblé la recherche primaire.

Exigences essentielles:

• Baccalauréat requis. Diplôme avancé (Ph.D., M.D. ou autre diplôme universitaire) et/ou expérience équivalente en sciences de la vie / soins de santé; MBA ou expérience de conseil ou expérience équivalente hautement préférée.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'AT (ou expérience pour acquérir l'expertise requise de l'AT efficacement et rapidement) en neuroscience.

Would you like to actively contribute to ensuring that life-changing medicines are produced reliably and to the highest quality? As an Equipment Operator at Novartis, you are an essential part of our production team and contribute every day to ensuring that our products are manufactured safely, on time and to the highest quality standards. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Are you ready to help shape how a leading global healthcare company partners, innovates, and delivers impact? As Legal Counsel Global Procurement, DD&IT, you will play a critical role in enabling strategic business decisions, advising on high-value commercial transactions, and helping teams navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of law, technology, procurement, and innovation while collaborating with stakeholders across the globe. Your primary focus will be supporting global Procurement activities, particularly indirect procurement, while partnering with DD&IT stakeholders on technology-related matters where required.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Partner with global Procurement teams as a trusted legal advisor on strategic sourcing initiatives.

• Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements for goods and services including technology, SaaS, AI and other digital solutions where required.

• Provide practical, risk-based legal guidance on commercial, operational, and governance matters.

• Support global projects and transactions while balancing legal risks with business objectives working independently and in collaboration with legal colleagues across jurisdictions.

• Deliver legal training and awareness sessions to Procurement and digital stakeholders.

• Identify, assess, and manage legal risks across procurement activities and technology-related projects . Assist in the management of disputes, dispute resolution matters and external counsel where appropriate.

• Collaborate across legal, compliance, and business teams to drive successful outcomes including supporting colleagues on cross-border matters requiring Swiss law expertise.

• Contribute to innovation, continuous improvement, and adoption of new legal technologies.

Essential Requirements

• Qualified Swiss lawyer with admission to the Swiss Bar.

• Post-qualification legal experience in a leading law firm or in an in-house role

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts combined with a pragmatic, and strong solution-oriented approach .

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Proven ability to provide practical, solution-focused legal advice in complex business environments.

• Experience advising on topics like SaaS, IT and artificial intelligence

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 126.000 - 234.000 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Adaptability, Business Acumen, Critical Thinking, Curious Mindset, Decision Making, Law, Legal Acumen, Legal Communication, Legal Issues, Legal Research, Legal Risk Analysis, Legal Support, Legal Writing, Negotiation, Persuasion, Proactive Planning, Problem Solving, Relationship Building, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Thinking

- Produzione conforme alle GMP di forme farmaceutiche solide, inclusi Precise Drug Processing (PDP), incapsulamento, compressione e/o granulazione, nonché esecuzione dei controlli durante il processo (IPC) o dei controlli dell'andamento del processo (PAK) e inserimento nel sistema MES
- Miscelazione, setacciatura e macinazione di principi attivi
- Utilizzo, inclusi allestimento, pulizia e disinfezione, degli impianti e dei locali di produzione
- Supporto nell'esecuzione della manutenzione & della calibrazione degli impianti di produzione e partecipazione ai progetti di investimento assegnati (ad es. nell'ambito della qualificazione e della messa in servizio)
- Campionamento delegato
- Responsabile dell'ordine e della pulizia nelle aree di attività e nei locali assegnati
- Responsabile di garantire la disponibilità degli impianti assegnati
- Responsabilità personale per la formazione continua/lo sviluppo costante
- Collaborazione all'attuazione e al rispetto delle misure 5S e IQP/miglioramento continuo (CI)
- Collaborazione alla preparazione di audit interni ed esterni & partecipazione attiva allo svolgimento degli audit
- Collaborazione al raggiungimento degli indicatori chiave di prestazione (KPI) specifici del Supply Team
- Collaborazione alla redazione / revisione dei documenti procedurali (SOP, WP, FRM)
- Rispetto delle direttive cGMP, HSE, integrità dei dati e ISEC (sicurezza delle informazioni)

Formazione professionale:

- Minimo: formazione professionale completata
- Desiderata: formazione professionale come tecnologo chimico e farmaceutico, nel settore alimentare o in un'azienda operante nell'igiene, oppure una formazione professionale tecnica con esperienza in un ambiente regolamentato dalle GMP (ad es. meccanico, meccatronico ecc.)

Conoscenze linguistiche:

- Minimo: Conoscenza fluente del tedesco (orale e scritta)
- Desiderato: Buona conoscenza dell'inglese (orale e scritta)

Esperienza professionale:

- È preferibile un'esperienza nell'ambito dello sviluppo di una produzione chimica o farmaceutica.
- Esperienza nella produzione di principi attivi (attività di setacciatura, miscelazione e macinazione) o di forme farmaceutiche solide (miscelazione, granulazione, setacciatura, macinazione, compattazione, estrusione, compressione in compresse, incapsulamento, cernita, rivestimento)
- Patentino per carrelli elevatori preferibile

Impegno a favore della diversità e dell'inclusione:

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal job title: Director
Location: Basel, Switzerland

The Director, Translational Medicine Expert (Neurodegeneration) will lead the end to end translational strategy for neurodegenerative programs, bridging preclinical research to early clinical development (Phase 1–2).
This role is accountable for biomarker strategy, clinical endpoint selection, and early phase trial design, enabling efficient, data driven decision-making through key development milestones (e.g., Transition Decision Points) and ensuring competitive differentiation of neuromuscular assets.
In addition, he/she oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials research, data collection activities and clinical operations. Establishes and approves scientific methods for design and implementation of clinical protocols, data collection systems and final reports. Support new and ongoing clinical research and clinical trials and ensure efficient and timely processing of confidentiality agreements and clinical agreements

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
1. Translational Strategy & Program Leadership

•
• Define and execute integrated translational strategies across neurodegeneration programs

• Lead translational components from preclinical → Phase 1/2 clinical studies

• Drive program progression through key decision gates (e.g., IND, TDP, IDPA)

• Ensure strong mechanistic linkage between target biology, biomarkers, and clinical endpoints

2. Biomarker & Endpoint Leadership

•
• Collaborate with Biomarker Development colleagues toward development and validation of:
• Molecular biomarkers (tissue, blood, CSF where applicable)

• Functional endpoints (strength, mobility, disease-specific measures)

• Patient-reported outcomes (PROs)

• Establishing quantitative biomarkers to support:
• Target engagement

• Disease modification

• Dose selection and PoC decisions

• Integrate biomarker strategy into clinical protocols and operational plans

• Drive early biomarker de‑risking , a key priority in neuromuscular programs

3. Early Clinical Development (Phase 1/2)

•
• Co‑lead design and execution of early clinical studies

• Define:
• Dose escalation strategy

• Exposure–response framework

• Translational endpoints (biopsy, imaging, functional)

• Ensure TM leadership within Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) for:
• Trial design

• Execution oversight

• Data interpretation and decision-making

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

•
• Serve as core Translational Medicine representative within global project teams

• Partner closely with:
• Clinical Development

• Biomarker Development

• Clinical Pharmacology (PKS)

• Preclinical Safety (PCS)

• Regulatory

• Drive alignment between research, TM, and development organizations

5. External Scientific Leadership

•
• Build and lead collaborations with:
• Academic KOLs

• Patient advocacy groups (critical in rare neuromuscular disease)

• Technology partners (imaging, omics platforms)

• Contribute to scientific strategy and external positioning of programs

6. Patient-Centered Development

•
• Integrate the patient voice into translational and clinical strategies

• Advance:
• Meaningful functional endpoints

• Patient-relevant outcome measures

• Innovative trial approaches (e.g., decentralized models where feasible)

7. Portfolio Contribution & Strategic Input

•
• Contribute to:
• Asset prioritization and portfolio strategy

• Competitive differentiation strategy (e.g., vs RNA or gene therapy competitors)

• Provide scientific input to:
• Business development / due diligence

• Indication expansion strategies

Essential Requirements:
· MD, neurologists, clinical training in neurodegenerative diseases
· Experience in translational medicine, early clinical development, or experimental therapeutics.
· Ability to shape development strategies, execute early clinical studies, and influence regulatory/packages supporting differentiation.

Desirable Requirements:
· Experience working in pharmaceutical/biotech company strongly preferred.
· PhD, PharmD, or equivalent in:
o Neurology / Neuroscience
o Neurodegenerative diseases

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF142,100.00 - CHF263,900.00

Job Description Summary
Imagine leading the organization that turns emerging technologies, scientific ambition, and bold ideas into software that helps researchers discover medicines faster.

As Director of Technology & Engineering within Novartis Biomedical Research Data & Digital Software & Workflows, you will shape how high-quality, AI-enabled software solutions are designed, built, and delivered across scientific workflows and laboratory processes. You will lead software engineering and AI engineering leaders, set a clear technical direction, and create the conditions for teams to deliver meaningful outcomes with speed, quality, and confidence.

This is an opportunity for a curious, learning-oriented technology leader who can navigate complexity, anticipate what is next, and translate strategy into focused execution. You will bring together talented people across engineering, science, architecture, operations, security, and enterprise technology, challenging established approaches, making thoughtful trade-offs, and helping teams learn and grow as they deliver.

Job Description
Internal job title: Director, Technology & Engineering
Position Location : Basel, CH

This role is based in Basel, CH. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

The Software & Workflows organization partners with scientists, data experts, and AI specialists across Novartis Biomedical Research to transform scientific workflows and laboratory processes. Our ambition is to make advanced digital and AI capabilities usable, scalable, and impactful, helping teams generate better insights, improve decisions, and accelerate the discovery of innovative medicines.

You will lead technology and engineering execution across a broad portfolio of time-bound software delivery initiatives. Your role will combine strategic technical leadership with delivery accountability: building a high-performing organization, advancing modern and AI-enabled engineering practices, and ensuring that solutions meet demanding standards for quality, performance, security, compliance, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead with purpose: Set a compelling direction for technology and engineering, connecting team priorities and technical choices to scientific impact and organizational strategy.

• Shape a learning culture: Encourage curiosity, experimentation, constructive challenge, and learning from outcomes while fostering urgency, trust, clarity, and shared ownership.

• Build exceptional teams: Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and AI engineering capabilities while creating opportunities for people to grow and thrive.

• Accelerate AI-enabled engineering: Champion the responsible integration of AI tools and agents into a robust, modern engineering framework and practices.

• Raise the engineering bar: Advance scalable architecture, DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, test automation, observability, and operational excellence.

• Protect sustainable value: Ensure engineering approaches align with enterprise strategy, architectural standards, security, compliance, and responsible AI governance.

• Influence beyond authority: Build trusted relationships across organizational boundaries and communicate complex technical topics in ways that enable timely, informed decisions.

• Create alignment: Partner with delivery, architecture, operations, security, compliance, enterprise technology teams, and software vendors to turn diverse perspectives into clear decisions and coordinated action.

• Deliver meaningful outcomes: Own engineering execution across a broad portfolio of initiatives, ensuring high-quality solutions are delivered predictably within agreed scope, budget, and timelines.

• Navigate complexity: Apply strategic agility to manage dependencies, risks, resources, and trade-offs, adapting plans as priorities and technologies evolve.

Essential Requirements
You are an inspiring and pragmatic technology leader who combines strategic perspective with a strong bias for execution. In short, while your expertise is in technology, your passion is with the outcomes. You are energized by complex problems, motivated by scientific impact, and committed to helping people perform at their best.

You bring:

• Significant experience leading technology functions, engineering managers, technical leaders, and multidisciplinary software teams in a global, matrixed environment.

• A strong learning mindset and curiosity, with the ability to explore emerging technologies, seek diverse perspectives, and turn new insights into practical action.

• Strategic agility—the ability to connect long-term direction with near-term priorities, simplify complexity, and adapt decisively as circumstances evolve.

• A track record of leading large-scale SaaS, commercial, custom-built, on-premises, and cloud-based software solutions with measurable business or scientific impact.

• Deep understanding of modern AI-enabled software engineering practices, including DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, test automation, and Agile or Lean delivery.

• Experience integrating AI models, agents, or other AI-enabled capabilities into production software and engineering workflows.

• Demonstrated success leading complex, time-bound initiatives and improving delivery predictability, quality, and operational performance.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders and translate technical complexity into clear choices and recommendations.

• A leadership style grounded in integrity, empowerment, accountability, collaboration, and genuine commitment to developing others.

• The courage to challenge the status quo, take thoughtful risks, learn quickly, and help teams turn uncertainty into progress.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry, life sciences, research, or another highly regulated environment.

• Experience leading globally distributed teams and collaborating across scientific, technical, vendor, and enterprise functions.

• Evidence of building inclusive, high-performing cultures in which people learn from one another and achieve more together.

What Success Looks Like
In this role, you will shape a technical organization known for clarity, learning, and dependable delivery excellence. Teams will understand how their work contributes to scientific outcomes, leaders will grow in capability and confidence, and partners will experience Technology & Engineering as a trusted force for progress. Together, you will turn emerging possibilities into reliable solutions that help advance drug discovery.

Accessibility and Accommodation:

Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Algorithms, Computer Programming, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Data Science, Global Project Management, Operational Excellence, People Management, R&D (Research And Development) (Inactive), Solutions Design

Descrizione del lavoro
Immagina di guidare l'organizzazione che trasforma le tecnologie emergenti, l'ambizione scientifica e idee audaci in software che aiuta i ricercatori a scoprire farmaci più velocemente.

In qualità di Direttore della Tecnologia e dell'Ingegneria all'interno di Novartis Biomedical Research Data & Digital Software & Workflows, formerai come le soluzioni software di alta qualità, abilitate all'IA siano progettate, costruite e fornite attraverso flussi di lavoro scientifici e processi di laboratorio. Potrai guidare l'ingegneria software e leader di ingegneria AI, impostare una chiara direzione tecnica, e creare le condizioni per i team di fornire risultati significativi con velocità, qualità e fiducia.

Questa è un'opportunità per un curioso leader tecnologico orientato all'apprendimento che può navigare nella complessità, anticipare ciò che è il prossimo, e tradurre la strategia in esecuzione focalizzata. Potrai riunire persone di talento in ingegneria, scienza, architettura, operazioni, sicurezza e tecnologia aziendale, sfidando approcci consolidati, facendo compromessi riflessivi, e aiutando i team a imparare e crescere come consegnare.

Descrizione del lavoro
Titolo del lavoro interno: Direttore, Tecnologia e Ingegneria
Posizione: Basilea, CH

Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, CH. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo: si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi.

L'organizzazione Software & Workflows collabora con scienziati, esperti di dati e specialisti dell'AI attraverso la ricerca biomedica di Novartis per trasformare i flussi di lavoro scientifici e i processi di laboratorio. La nostra ambizione è quella di rendere le funzionalità digitali e AI avanzate utilizzabili, scalabili e d'impatto, aiutando i team a generare migliori intuizioni, migliorare le decisioni e accelerare la scoperta di farmaci innovativi.

Potrai condurre la tecnologia e l'esecuzione di ingegneria attraverso un ampio portafoglio di iniziative di consegna software a tempo. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di combinare la leadership tecnica strategica con la responsabilità della consegna: costruire un'organizzazione altamente performante, avanzare pratiche ingegneristiche moderne e AI-enabled, e garantire che le soluzioni soddisfino standard esigenti per qualità, prestazioni, sicurezza, conformità e affidabilità.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare con lo scopo: impostare una direzione convincente per la tecnologia e l'ingegneria, collegare le priorità del team e le scelte tecniche per l'impatto scientifico e la strategia organizzativa.

• Formare una cultura dell'apprendimento: Incoraggiare la curiosità, la sperimentazione, la sfida costruttiva e imparare dai risultati, promuovendo l'urgenza, la fiducia, la chiarezza e la proprietà condivisa.

• Costruire team eccezionali: Lead, coach e sviluppare manager di ingegneria, leader tecnici e capacità di ingegneria AI, creando opportunità per le persone a crescere e prosperare.

• Accelera l'ingegneria abilitata all'intelligenza artificiale: Campioni l'integrazione responsabile di strumenti e agenti dell'IA in un robusto e moderno quadro ingegneristico e pratiche.

• Alzare la barra di ingegneria: Architettura scalabile avanzata, DevOps, integrazione e consegna continua, automazione di test, osservanza e eccellenza operativa.

• Proteggere il valore sostenibile: assicurarsi che gli approcci ingegneristici siano allineati alla strategia aziendale, agli standard architettonici, alla sicurezza, alla conformità e alla governance AI responsabile.

• Influenza al di là dell'autorità: costruire relazioni di fiducia attraverso i confini organizzativi e comunicare argomenti tecnici complessi in modi che permettono decisioni tempestive e informate.

• Crea allineamento: Partner di fornitura, architettura, operazioni, sicurezza, conformità, team di tecnologia aziendale e fornitori di software per trasformare diverse prospettive in decisioni chiare e azioni coordinate.

• Fornire risultati significativi: la propria esecuzione di ingegneria attraverso un ampio portafoglio di iniziative, assicurando soluzioni di alta qualità vengono consegnate prevedibilmente all'interno del campo di applicazione concordato, budget e timeline.

• Navigare complessità: Applicare agilità strategica per gestire dipendenze, rischi, risorse e trade-off, adattando i piani come priorità e tecnologie si evolvono.

Requisiti essenziali
Sei un leader tecnologico stimolante e pragmatico che combina una prospettiva strategica con un forte pregiudizio per l'esecuzione. In breve, mentre la vostra esperienza è nella tecnologia, la vostra passione è con i risultati. Siete eccitati da problemi complessi, motivati da impatto scientifico, e impegnati ad aiutare le persone a svolgere al meglio.

Tu porti:

• Esperienza significativa leader funzioni tecnologiche, manager di ingegneria, leader tecnici e team di software multidisciplinari in un ambiente globale, matrice.

• Una forte mentalità di apprendimento e curiosità, con la capacità di esplorare le tecnologie emergenti, cercare prospettive diverse e trasformare nuove intuizioni in azione pratica.

• Agilità strategica—la capacità di collegare la direzione a lungo termine con priorità a breve termine, semplificare la complessità e adattarsi in modo decisivo quando le circostanze si evolvono.

• Un track record di leader su larga scala SaaS, commerciale, su misura, on-premises e soluzioni software basate su cloud con un impatto commerciale o scientifico.

• Comprensione profonda delle moderne pratiche di ingegneria del software abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale, tra cui DevOps, integrazione continua e consegna, automazione dei test e consegna Agile o Lean.

• Esperienza nell'integrazione di modelli, agenti, o di altre capacità abilitate dall'IA nei flussi di lavoro di produzione e di ingegneria.

• Demonstrated successo leader complesse, iniziative a lungo termine e migliorare la prevedibilità di consegna, la qualità e le prestazioni operative.

• Ottima comunicazione e capacità di influenzare, tra cui la capacità di coinvolgere i leader senior e tradurre la complessità tecnica in scelte e raccomandazioni chiare.

• Uno stile di leadership basato sull'integrità, l'empowerment, la responsabilità, la collaborazione e l'impegno autentico per lo sviluppo di altri.

• Il coraggio di sfidare lo status quo, prendere rischi riflessivi, imparare rapidamente e aiutare le squadre a trasformare l'incertezza in progresso.

Requisiti desiderabili

• Esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica, scienze della vita, ricerca, o un altro ambiente altamente regolamentato.

• Esperienza leader a livello globale team distribuiti e la collaborazione tra funzioni scientifiche, tecniche, fornitori e aziendali.

• Prove di costruzione di culture inclusive e ad alto rendimento in cui le persone imparano l'un l'altro e ottengono più insieme.

Che successo sembra
In questo ruolo, formerai un'organizzazione tecnica nota per chiarezza, apprendimento e affidabili eccellenze di consegna. I team capiranno come il loro lavoro contribuisce ai risultati scientifici, i leader cresceranno in capacità e fiducia, e i partner sperimenteranno Technology & Engineering come una forza di fiducia per il progresso. Insieme, si trasformerà le possibilità emergenti in soluzioni affidabili che aiutano a far progredire la scoperta della droga.

Accessibilità e alloggio:

Novartis si impegna a lavorare con e fornire alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o disabilità, è necessario un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di una posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com e farci conoscere la natura della vostra richiesta e le vostre informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di richiesta di lavoro nel messaggio.

Competenze desiderate
Algoritmi, Computer Programming, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Data Science, Global Project Management, Operational Excellence, People Management, R&D (Ricerca e Sviluppo) (Inactive), Solutions Design

Imaginez diriger l'organisation qui transforme les technologies émergentes, l'ambition scientifique et les idées audacieuses en logiciels qui aident les chercheurs à découvrir les médicaments plus rapidement.

En tant que directeur de la technologie et de l'ingénierie au sein de Novartis Biomedical Research Data & Digital Software & Workflows, vous façonnerez la conception, la construction et la distribution de solutions logicielles de haute qualité, adaptées à l'IA, à travers les workflows scientifiques et les processus de laboratoire. Vous dirigerez des chefs de file en génie logiciel et en génie de l'IA, établirez une orientation technique claire et créerez les conditions pour que les équipes produisent des résultats significatifs avec rapidité, qualité et confiance.

C'est l'occasion pour un chef de file technique curieux et axé sur l'apprentissage de naviguer dans la complexité, d'anticiper ce qui va suivre et de traduire la stratégie en exécution ciblée. Vous rassemblerez des personnes talentueuses dans les domaines de l'ingénierie, des sciences, de l'architecture, des opérations, de la sécurité et de la technologie d'entreprise, en défiant les approches établies, en faisant des compromis réfléchis et en aidant les équipes à apprendre et à croître au fur et à mesure de leur prestation.

Description de l'emploi
Titre du poste interne : Directeur, Technologie et Ingénierie
Emplacement : Bâle, CH

Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, CH. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir un soutien à la réinstallation pour ce rôle : veuillez ne postuler que si cet emplacement est accessible pour vous.

L'organisation Software & Workflows collabore avec des scientifiques, des experts en données et des spécialistes de l'IA dans l'ensemble de Novartis Biomedical Research pour transformer les flux de travail scientifiques et les processus de laboratoire. Notre ambition est de rendre les capacités numériques et d'IA avancées utilisables, évolutives et impactées, aidant les équipes à générer de meilleures idées, à améliorer les décisions et à accélérer la découverte de médicaments innovants.

Vous dirigerez l'exécution de la technologie et de l'ingénierie dans un vaste portefeuille d'initiatives de livraison de logiciels assorties de délais. Votre rôle combinera leadership technique stratégique et responsabilité de prestation : bâtir une organisation performante, faire progresser les pratiques d'ingénierie modernes et adaptées à l'IA, et s'assurer que les solutions répondent aux normes exigeantes en matière de qualité, de performance, de sécurité, de conformité et de fiabilité.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger avec objectif : Établir une orientation convaincante pour la technologie et l'ingénierie, relier les priorités de l'équipe et les choix techniques à l'impact scientifique et à la stratégie organisationnelle.

• Façonner une culture d'apprentissage : Encourager la curiosité, l'expérimentation, le défi constructif et l'apprentissage à partir des résultats tout en favorisant l'urgence, la confiance, la clarté et l'appropriation partagée.

• Bâtir des équipes exceptionnelles : Diriger, coacher et développer des gestionnaires d'ingénierie, des dirigeants techniques et des capacités d'ingénierie de l'IA tout en créant des occasions pour les gens de grandir et de prospérer.

• Accélérer l'ingénierie assistée par l'IA : Championne de l'intégration responsable des outils et des agents d'IA dans un cadre et des pratiques d'ingénierie robuste et moderne.

• Augmenter la barre d'ingénierie : Architecture évolutive avancée, DevOps, intégration et livraison continues, automatisation des tests, observabilité et excellence opérationnelle.

• Protéger la valeur durable : Veiller à ce que les approches d'ingénierie cadrent avec la stratégie d'entreprise, les normes architecturales, la sécurité, la conformité et la gouvernance responsable de l'IA.

• Influence au-delà de l'autorité : Établir des relations de confiance au-delà des limites de l'organisation et communiquer des sujets techniques complexes de manière à permettre des décisions éclairées et opportunes.

• Créer un alignement: Partenaire avec la prestation, l'architecture, les opérations, la sécurité, la conformité, les équipes technologiques d'entreprise, et les fournisseurs de logiciels pour transformer diverses perspectives en décisions claires et une action coordonnée.

• Produire des résultats significatifs : Sa propre exécution technique dans un vaste portefeuille d'initiatives, en veillant à ce que des solutions de haute qualité soient fournies de façon prévisible dans les limites de la portée, du budget et des délais convenus.

• Naviguer dans la complexité : Appliquer l'agilité stratégique pour gérer les dépendances, les risques, les ressources et les compromis, en adaptant les plans à mesure que les priorités et les technologies évoluent.

Exigences essentielles
Vous êtes un leader technologique inspirant et pragmatique qui combine une perspective stratégique avec un fort biais pour l'exécution. Bref, alors que votre expertise est dans la technologie, votre passion est avec les résultats. Vous êtes stimulé par des problèmes complexes, motivés par l'impact scientifique, et engagés à aider les gens à se produire à leur meilleur.

• agilité stratégique – la capacité de relier l'orientation à long terme aux priorités à court terme, de simplifier la complexité et de s'adapter de façon décisive à mesure que les circonstances évoluent.

• Une expérience des solutions logicielles SaaS à grande échelle, commerciales, sur mesure, sur site et en nuage avec un impact commercial ou scientifique mesurable.

• Compréhension approfondie des pratiques modernes d'ingénierie logicielle utilisant l'IA, y compris DevOps, intégration et livraison continues, automatisation des tests et livraison Agile ou Lean.

• Expérience d'intégration de modèles, d'agents ou d'autres capacités compatibles avec l'IA dans les processus de production et d'ingénierie.

• Succès démontré menant des initiatives complexes et assorties de délais et améliorant la prévisibilité, la qualité et le rendement opérationnel.

• Excellente communication et influence des compétences, y compris la capacité de mobiliser les cadres supérieurs et de traduire la complexité technique en choix et recommandations clairs.

• Un style de leadership fondé sur l'intégrité, l'autonomisation, l'obligation de rendre compte, la collaboration et un engagement sincère en faveur du développement des autres.

• Le courage de contester le statu quo, de prendre des risques réfléchis, d'apprendre rapidement et d'aider les équipes à transformer l'incertitude en progrès.

Exigences souhaitables

• Expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, les sciences de la vie, la recherche ou un autre environnement hautement réglementé.

• Expérience de la direction d'équipes réparties à l'échelle mondiale et collaboration dans les fonctions scientifiques, techniques, de fournisseurs et d'entreprise.

• Preuve de la construction de cultures inclusives et performantes dans lesquelles les gens apprennent les uns des autres et réalisent plus ensemble.

À quoi ressemble le succès
Dans ce rôle, vous façonnerez une organisation technique connue pour sa clarté, son apprentissage et son excellence de prestation fiable. Les équipes comprendront comment leur travail contribue aux résultats scientifiques, les dirigeants se développeront en capacité et en confiance, et les partenaires feront de la technologie et de l'ingénierie une force de confiance pour le progrès. Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland

#LI-Hybrid 3 days/week in office

Internal job title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Data42

About the Role:
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Data42 is an embedded technical delivery leader who partners directly with domain teams to turn high-value problems into working data and AI applications. You will rapidly prototype, iterate, and productionize solutions on Palantir Foundry, bridging users, product, and platform engineering to deliver measurable outcomes. This role blends software engineering, data engineering, and product-oriented problem solving, with a strong emphasis on user workflow adoption and operational durability.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Embedded delivery and problem solving: Embed with domain teams to understand workflows, define success criteria, and translate needs into shipped capabilities; Lead discovery, solution framing, and iterative delivery from prototype to production.

• Build on Palantir Foundry : Design and implement end-to-end solutions in Foundry , including data pipelines, transformations, ontology alignment, and application workflows; Configure and optimize Foundry-based applications to support operational decision-making and repeatable analytics; Apply Foundry-native patterns for permissions, auditability, performance, and release management.

• Data engineering and modeling : Ingest, transform, and model diverse datasets to make them usable and trustworthy for analytics and applications; Define data quality checks and ensure datasets are fit for intended use (document assumptions and limitations).

• Application development and integration : Build user-facing applications or workflow experiences and integrate with upstream and downstream systems as needed; Support deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of production applications.

• Cross-functional leadership : Partner closely with product managers, data scientists, data engineers, governance, and platform teams to align scope, timelines, and standards; Communicate trade-offs clearly and unblock delivery through technical and stakeholder influence.

• Enablement and reuse : Create reusable templates, components, and patterns to accelerate future deliveries across Data42; Mentor teammates and contribute to internal documentation, playbooks, and delivery standards.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelors degree in Biology, Bioengineering, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics or related discipline.

• 8+ years of experience working in biomedical research, bioengineering, bioinformatics or related domain.

• Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry is essential, building and operationalizing solutions (pipelines, ontology, applications, and access controls), with a Foundry-first engineering and delivery mindset.

• Solid experience in partnering with stakeholders to understand challenges and define effective solutions, developing and delivering Proof of Concepts to validate ideas and demonstrate business value.

• Demonstrated experience delivering software, data, or analytics products in a fast-paced, user-facing environment, with expertise in rapid prototyping to production execution.

• Strong programming skills and comfort working across data and application layers.

• Strong user empathy and workflow orientation, with proven ability to work directly with end users, clarify ambiguous requirements, and deliver iteratively.

• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management skills, with strong reliability and operational discipline.

Desirable requirements:

• Experience delivering solutions in regulated or sensitive-data environments, with strong attention to access control and audit needs.

• Familiarity with product discovery methods (problem framing, value definition, iterative MVP delivery).

• Experience with analytics, AI, or machine learning enablement within production applications.

​ Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.
Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 129,500 to CHF 240,500 .
The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.
The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Why Novartis?
Our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives and our vision is to become the most valued and trusted medicines company in the world. How can we achieve this? With our people. It is our associates that drive us each day to reach our ambitions. Be a part of this mission and join us! Learn more here: https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Join our Novartis Network: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to learn more about Novartis and our career opportunities, join the Novartis Network here: https://talentnetwork.novartis.com/network

Skills Desired
Artificial Intelligence (AI), Biostatistics, Business Value Creation, Change Management, Curious Mindset, Data Governance, Data Literacy, Data Quality, Data Science, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Graph Algorithms, Learning Agility, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Algorithms, Nlp (Neuro-Linguistic Programming) And Genai (Inactive), Organization Awareness (Inactive), Pandas (Python) (Inactive), Python (Programming Language), R Programming, Stakeholder Engagement, Statistical Analysis, Structured Query Language (SQL), Time Series Analysis

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Consegna incorporata e problem solving: incorporare con i team di dominio per comprendere i flussi di lavoro, definire i criteri di successo e tradurre le esigenze in capacità spedite; Guida scoperta, soluzione di inquadratura e consegna iterativa dal prototipo alla produzione.

What if your expertise in biochemistry and biophysics could help identify the anticancer medicines of the future? As a Scientific Associate in our Oncology Biochemistry group, you will develop innovative assays, characterize protein targets, and investigate how promising compounds work. Supporting both low molecular weight and radioligand therapy projects, you will collaborate across disciplines and sites to generate high-quality scientific insights that advance oncology drug discovery.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute innovative biochemical and biophysical assays using diverse technologies, with emphasis on surface plasmon resonance.

• Contribute to the functional characterization of protein targets supporting oncology drug discovery projects.

• Profile compounds and investigate their mechanisms of action across low molecular weight and radioligand therapy programs.

• Analyze, interpret, and document experimental data in electronic laboratory notebooks and scientific reports.

• Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary, cross-functional, and multi-site project teams.

• Present experimental findings, conclusions, and recommendations clearly to project teams and internal stakeholders.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biochemistry, Biophysics, or a related discipline. This position is not intended for doctoral or postdoctoral candidates.

• Practical laboratory experience in a comparable research position.

• Hands-on experience with biochemical assays, including time-resolved fluorescence resonance energy transfer, fluorescence polarization, and enzyme assays.

• Practical expertise in biophysical methods, particularly surface plasmon resonance.

• Experience analyzing protein-ligand interactions, including standard curve fitting and data interpretation.

• Basic knowledge of laboratory automation using small-scale workstations, together with fluency in English.

Desirable Requirements

• Previous laboratory experience supporting drug discovery research.

• Proficiency in German or French in addition to English.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: Yes

Are you ready to shape pricing and access strategies for innovative Immunology medicines on a global scale?

As Director, Pricing and Contracting, Immunology, you will play a critical role in developing and implementing launch and in-market pricing strategies that maximize patient access and optimize the long-term value of Novartis assets. Reporting to the Executive Director, Pricing and Contracting, Immunology, you will partner closely with Therapeutic Areas, Strategy & Growth, Access, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Finance, Policy, and key markets to drive strategic pricing decisions across the product lifecycle. This highly collaborative international role offers the opportunity to influence pricing strategy, launch sequencing, business case development, and contracting approaches while serving as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across regions and countries. If you are passionate about solving complex market access challenges, collaborating across diverse teams, and shaping the future of pricing innovation, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful global impact.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Support the development and execution of pricing strategies for assigned compounds and indications, ensuring alignment with brand and market access objectives.

• Collaborate on pricing research with international functions, countries, and regions to identify competitive trends and pricing opportunities.

• Design and oversee global launch sequence optimization for assigned assets and indications to maximize pricing and access outcomes.

• Develop and co-create pricing and access models, providing strategic recommendations to optimize value realization.

• Provide pricing input into early-stage assets and due diligence projects, including price, dosing, endpoint, comparator selection, and loss of exclusivity strategies.

• Act as a pricing expert for assigned countries and share insights on key market developments and emerging trends.

• Partner regularly with countries to conduct pricing scenario analyses and support local pricing decision-making processes.

• Review and endorse product price proposals, monitor implementation of pricing and contracting decisions, support pricing documentation requirements, and drive best-practice sharing across regions and functions.

Essential Requirements:

• Min 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical companies, Health Technology Assessment agencies, healthcare consultancies, or related organizations.

• Extensive experience in pricing, market access, and commercial strategy across multiple brands and therapeutic areas.

• Strong above-country experience, including regional or global pricing and access responsibilities.

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights and recommendations.

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and financial understanding.

• Demonstrated success working across functions, including Therapeutic Areas, Value & Access, Strategy & Growth, and Finance teams.

• Experience preparing and negotiating reimbursement submissions, Health Technology Assessment engagements, and pricing strategies with payers in major markets.

• Proficient English, both written and spoken.

Desirable Requirements:

• Advanced degree such as a Doctor of Philosophy, Master's degree, or equivalent qualification in Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, Health Policy, Health Economics, or a related field.

• Experience within the Immunology therapeutic area.
